personalityQuestion.en: Why does the order of inquiry matter after Descartes divides a difficulty?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 為什麼笛卡兒說拆開難題以後還要從簡單處推進？

personalityAnswer.zh: 先说明容易确立的部分，才能查后一步是否依赖尚未解决的前提。
personalityAnswer.en: The order lets a reader check whether a later step relies on something already established.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 先說明容易確立的部分，才能查後一步是否依賴尚未解決的前提。

narrative.zh:
巴克斯特的《改革宗牧师》在原题里点明亲自教导和教理问答，还指向就相关工作达成约定的伍斯特郡牧师。题名给读者一个明确入口：这是一份写给承担具体工作的人的文本。若只看流传的短书名，就容易忽略书中意见与牧师之间的约定有什么关系。把作者的教导内容和同业约定放在一起，可追问这本书是怎样为行动说理，而不把每次教导的实际经过当成书页上已经保存的事件。要知道当时怎样进行，需要具体场合的独立记录。

重看原题，可以先读它怎样称呼收信的群体，再找与个人教导有关的正文语句，看看一次说话、逐人交谈和持续实行的要求怎样被区分。若读者说几位牧师签订的是同一份安排，可以回到题名和前置文字核对它究竟怎样表述承诺。若进一步说每一位签署者后来都做到某些事，则还需要回到教区档案、书信或其他活动记录。一个人参加共同计划，并不表示所有人以相同方式执行，也不保证接受教导的人留下同样的评价。

费马从巴克斯特给共同工作写下目标和对象的行动来作传记解读。卷首指明正在承担职责的人，因此读者能检查这项建议是面向同业，还是直接写给其他听众。这样，可以谈教导如何被组织和劝勉怎样与实践相连，仍保留质疑建议可否实行的空间。要描述这一工作在其他地方的延续，应找得到另一组有地点和人员可查的材料。当前有明确出处的线索是，他把关于个人教导的任务写给一群当时考虑怎样配合的牧师。
narrative.en:
The original title of The Reformed Pastor names personal instruction and catechizing and refers to the Worcestershire ministers who signed an agreement about the work. This gives the book an address more specific than someone picking up its familiar short title might expect. The readers it names were considering a particular form of practice. A claim about how the author tried to organize the work can begin with that description. It need not become a claim that the title records every conversation between a minister and a person receiving instruction. The book helps a reader see how a proposal was addressed to colleagues. A dated account of a visit or other activity could show what took place on a separate occasion.

Look first at how the title describes its audience. A later reader can then locate passages about personal instruction and consider what regular commitments they involve. It helps to distinguish a statement addressed to a group from an interaction between particular people. The agreement named in the title is evidence of a common undertaking. It is not proof that each participant followed identical practices or that each community responded to them in the same way. Those claims would call for correspondence, local records, or another account of the work. Reading the title with the book can establish what was put before the participating ministers without losing the possibility of comparing what happened in different places.

The biographical action here is addressing colleagues by means of a document that identifies a kind of work they were trying to carry out. That allows the profile to discuss the organization of instruction as something other people could recognize and debate. A reader could support the aim while questioning whether one practice could be continued with the people and time available. An answer about implementation would need to identify a setting different from the book’s address. If similar arrangements are found elsewhere, their dates and participants can be compared with those of this case. The source used here leaves a clear record of whom Baxter addressed and how the written work relates to an agreement about personal teaching.
narrative.zh-TW:
巴克斯特的《改革宗牧師》在原題裡點明親自教導和教理問答，還指向就相關工作達成約定的伍斯特郡牧師。題名給讀者一個明確入口：這是一份寫給承擔具體工作的人的文本。若只看流傳的短書名，就容易忽略書中意見與牧師之間的約定有什麼關係。把作者的教導內容和同業約定放在一起，可追問這本書是怎樣為行動說理，而不把每次教導的實際經過當成書頁上已經保存的事件。要知道當時怎樣進行，需要具體場合的獨立記錄。

重看原題，可以先讀它怎樣稱呼收信的群體，再找與個人教導有關的正文語句，看看一次說話、逐人交談和持續實行的要求怎樣被區分。若讀者說幾位牧師簽訂的是同一份安排，可以回到題名和前置文字核對它究竟怎樣表述承諾。若進一步說每一位簽署者後來都做到某些事，則還需要回到教區檔案、書信或其他活動記錄。一個人參加共同計劃，並不表示所有人以相同方式執行，也不保證接受教導的人留下同樣的評價。

費馬從巴克斯特給共同工作寫下目標和對象的行動來作傳記解讀。卷首指明正在承擔職責的人，因此讀者能檢查這項建議是面向同業，還是直接寫給其他聽眾。這樣，可以談教導如何被組織和勸勉怎樣與實踐相連，仍保留質疑建議可否實行的空間。要描述這一工作在其他地方的延續，應找得到另一組有地點和人員可查的材料。當前有明確出處的線索是，他把關於個人教導的任務寫給一群當時考慮怎樣配合的牧師。

personalityQuestion.zh: 巴克斯特的书为什么在原题中点名伍斯特郡牧师？
personalityQuestion.en: Why does it matter that Baxter’s original title identifies the Worcestershire ministers?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 巴克斯特的書為什麼在原題中點名伍斯特郡牧師？

personalityAnswer.zh: 题名把个人教导的主张放入已经讨论共同工作的同业群体，给建议确定了对象。
personalityAnswer.en: It links his proposals for instruction to colleagues associated with a particular undertaking.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 題名把個人教導的主張放入已經討論共同工作的同業群體，給建議確定了對象。

narrative.zh:
剑桥大学基督学院展出的《失乐园》校订本，让班特利和反对他的读者在同一本书里留下不同痕迹。班特利的版本于1732年出版，威廉·考珀后来在页边写下对他改动的异议。排印部分和手写部分各有日期与作者，本来受众也不同。若只从馆藏题名认得这是一本关于密尔顿的书，就可能看不见这一册还保留了一次阅读争论。将这两种文字分开，才能判断哪条意见是校订者提出的，哪条是在阅读过程中反驳他的。

要分析一处改动，可以先记下原有行文和班特利给出的替换，再看边上的反驳究竟针对改词、语气，还是校订计划中用来解释改动的理由。若有其他副本，比较其同页可以分出这册独有的手迹和印本应当共有的内容。考珀的意见证明他不同意这些改动，但不能代替所有同时期读者的态度。也不可用猜想补写手迹没有提及的反对理由。馆方说明让批注作者和书的版次可以确认，实际的文学判断则由读者回到具体文本来做。

这一册书使费马能够讨论班特利怎样把个人的校勘建议放入可受公开批评的版本中。所选改动提供地点，边批显示读者可以从另一个标准发起反驳。无论今天赞同哪一方，两者并列都让争议以真实的文字存在，而不必还原为校订者生前是否一贯强势的印象。想理解其他读者，应该寻找他们自己的副本和评论。档案保留的是一个可以在页上直接看出的例子，说明校订行为怎样改变阅读对象，也说明对改动的疑问怎样回到同一处继续讨论。
narrative.en:
The annotated copy of Milton’s Paradise Lost exhibited by Christ’s College brings together a printed intervention and a reader’s answer. Bentley’s emended edition appeared in 1732. William Cowper wrote objections to proposed changes in the margins of this particular copy. Print and handwriting supply contributions by different people and should be identified separately. A description of the book merely as a copy of Milton would miss part of what the object preserves. Conversely, understanding the manuscript notes as if they were printed by Bentley would assign every objection to the editor they challenge. The catalogue gives a reader a way to locate both the edition and the person behind the annotations.

A useful starting point is one altered line. Identify the wording before the intervention, the printed alternative, and what the marginal note actually takes up. The note might question a substitution, an effect on the passage, or a reason advanced for the change. A second copy of the printing can help separate features common to the edition from handwriting particular to this item. One can use the annotation as evidence that a reader objected without turning it into a statement about what every contemporary thought. A disagreement the annotator does not state should also be left open. The museum description helps locate the layers of the item, while the judgment about the passage can be made by returning to the text.

The profile looks at the choice to place proposed corrections into a form in which other readers could encounter and challenge them. The contested change now has a specific position. Cowper’s marks show that a reader could go back to a decision and contest it according to a different view of the poem. The evidence remains useful whichever reading a present reader favors. It gives more precision than describing Bentley as forceful and assuming that this quality explains an editorial change. A broader study of reception would have to look at other copies or other criticism. In this case the book provides one visible example of a proposal becoming part of an object that a reader could mark, question, and return to in the same place.
narrative.zh-TW:
劍橋大學基督學院展出的《失樂園》校訂本，讓班特利和反對他的讀者在同一本書裡留下不同痕跡。班特利的版本於1732年出版，威廉·考珀後來在頁邊寫下對他改動的異議。排印部分和手寫部分各有日期與作者，本來受眾也不同。若只從館藏題名認得這是一本關於密爾頓的書，就可能看不見這一冊還保留了一次閱讀爭論。將這兩種文字分開，才能判斷哪條意見是校訂者提出的，哪條是在閱讀過程中反駁他的。

要分析一處改動，可以先記下原有行文和班特利給出的替換，再看邊上的反駁究竟針對改詞、語氣，還是校訂計劃中用來解釋改動的理由。若有其他副本，比較其同頁可以分出這冊獨有的手跡和印本應當共有的內容。考珀的意見證明他不同意這些改動，但不能代替所有同時期讀者的態度。也不可用猜想補寫手跡沒有提及的反對理由。館方說明讓批註作者和書的版次可以確認，實際的文學判斷則由讀者回到具體文本來做。

這一冊書使費馬能夠討論班特利怎樣把個人的校勘建議放入可受公開批評的版本中。所選改動提供地點，邊批顯示讀者可以從另一個標準發起反駁。無論今天贊同哪一方，兩者並列都讓爭議以真實的文字存在，而不必還原為校訂者生前是否一貫強勢的印象。想理解其他讀者，應該尋找他們自己的副本和評論。檔案保留的是一個可以在頁上直接看出的例子，說明校訂行為怎樣改變閱讀對象，也說明對改動的疑問怎樣回到同一處繼續討論。

personalityQuestion.zh: 为什么剑桥展出的这册《失乐园》能帮助理解班特利的校订？
personalityQuestion.en: What makes the annotated Cambridge copy useful for assessing Bentley’s editorial choice?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 為什麼劍橋展出的這冊《失樂園》能幫助理解班特利的校訂？

personalityAnswer.zh: 能在同一页区分他付印的改动和考珀后来写下的异议，再回到原文比较。
personalityAnswer.en: It places the printed proposal beside a reader’s identifiable objection.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 能在同一頁區分他付印的改動和考珀後來寫下的異議，再回到原文比較。

narrative.zh:
英国国家档案馆的谷物法资料把科布登、布赖特与反谷物法同盟的宣传联系起来，并概括了粮食价格和自由贸易在倡议中的位置。粮价是一户人家能够在采购时辨认的事情，贸易规则则涉及更大范围的进出货物。把两个问题放在同一论证里，使行动目标能从一项制度要求转译为听众每天可能遇到的困难。档案说明了他们曾怎样主张，却没有让这些主张变成价格后来确实改变多少的证明。政策效果需要在政策变动以后查别的资料。

分析宣传时，可以从一份演说或海报找出它希望听众立即理解哪种生活成本，再问这项证据怎样接到废法的要求上。若某一句将较自由的贸易同便宜粮食直接相连，可以记录这个说法，再核查是否列出了时间、地区和会产生影响的其他条件。如此既可看见宣传为何试图用生活开支说明法规，又能避免拿同盟自己的判断代替对实际粮价的考证。谁说了某句话也要由具体文件确认，不能由同盟成员身份推知。

费马依据的是科布登参与选择怎样表达一个政策目标。把讨论引向家庭买粮的实际问题，有助于在复杂制度与潜在参与者之间搭出清楚联系。这个动作可以沿原有宣传材料追查，不需要宣称所有支持者都以同一种理由站到一起。作为传记证据，本页的重点是具体目标怎样被说给某群人听，实际制度后果仍能独立检验。
narrative.en:
The National Archives material on the Corn Laws associates Richard Cobden and John Bright with the League’s campaign and with arguments for lower food prices and freer trade. A grocery purchase and a rule about imports present different ways for a listener to encounter the issue. Putting both into one argument made it possible to connect a proposed institutional change with a cost a household could recognize. The archive documents the case the campaigners made. Its description of their aims does not establish by itself the size or timing of any movement in prices after a change in law. A study of the effect would require other records and would have to identify when and where prices were being compared.

When examining one speech or printed appeal, identify the expense it asks an audience to think about and follow the reasoning from that expense to the requested change. A market quotation can document a particular price. A parliamentary debate can give the terms of a proposal. A campaign document can show which visible part of the issue was chosen to draw those things together for a group of listeners. A claim connecting the two subjects can be checked for what it says about the place or conditions where a change was expected. If a reader wants to attribute particular words to Cobden rather than the League generally, the speaker or author should be identified in the original item. 

The profile considers how Cobden participated in choosing a form in which to communicate a policy aim. An appeal to the expense of buying food gives people a concrete place to begin examining a complicated rule. The form of the appeal can be traced without assuming that all its supporters had the same reasons. Then readers could see whether the proposed outcome was presented in the same sequence. The focus here remains on the relationship between a subject of institutional debate and an example chosen for the people whose attention the campaign sought. A judgment about results stays available to separate historical inquiry.
narrative.zh-TW:
英國國家檔案館的穀物法資料把科布登、布賴特與反穀物法同盟的宣傳聯絡起來，並概括了糧食價格和自由貿易在倡議中的位置。糧價是一戶人家能夠在採購時辨認的事情，貿易規則則涉及更大範圍的進出貨物。把兩個問題放在同一論證裡，使行動目標能從一項制度要求轉譯為聽眾每天可能遇到的困難。檔案說明了他們曾怎樣主張，卻沒有讓這些主張變成價格後來確實改變多少的證明。政策效果需要在政策變動以後查別的資料。

分析宣傳時，可以從一份演說或海報找出它希望聽眾立即理解哪種生活成本，再問這項證據怎樣接到廢法的要求上。若某一句將較自由的貿易同便宜糧食直接相連，可以記錄這個說法，再核查是否列出了時間、地區和會產生影響的其他條件。如此既可看見宣傳為何試圖用生活開支說明法規，又能避免拿同盟自己的判斷代替對實際糧價的考證。誰說了某句話也要由具體檔案確認，不能由同盟成員身份推知。

費馬依據的是科布登參與選擇怎樣表達一個政策目標。把討論引向家庭買糧的實際問題，有助於在複雜制度與潛在參與者之間搭出清楚聯絡。這個動作可以沿原有宣傳材料追查，不需要宣稱所有支持者都以同一種理由站到一起。作為傳記證據，本頁的重點是具體目標怎樣被說給某群人聽，實際制度後果仍能獨立檢驗。

personalityQuestion.zh: 科布登的宣传为什么从家庭粮价讲到贸易规则？
personalityQuestion.en: Why does Cobden’s campaign connect household food costs to trade rules?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 科布登的宣傳為什麼從家庭糧價講到貿易規則？

personalityAnswer.zh: 粮价是听众容易核对的生活例子，倡议用它说明法规与家庭开支的关系。
personalityAnswer.en: The costs gave audiences a familiar practical issue through which to examine the proposed change.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 糧價是聽眾容易核對的生活例子，倡議用它說明法規與家庭開支的關係。

narrative.zh:
拜罗伊特音乐节的历史说明从一处具体限制讲起：华格纳考察当地旧歌剧院后，认为它的空间不足以举办想要的演出。此后采用的是另建剧院的办法，设计工作由奥托·布吕克瓦尔德承担，场馆于1876年开放。对已有建筑的判断明确了问题，由谁作建筑设计是第二项证据，开放日期标示项目进入实际使用的节点。即使整件事在后来的介绍中以作曲家名字统摄，也不应该把每项设计都写成他本人亲手绘制。

比较两个场馆，可以先问打算举办的场次需要什么，由旧场地是否合适说到新场馆解决哪些要求。若要说明一个具体声学效果，最好找到图纸、当时的说明或现场记录。不能由新剧院建成自动推定每项效果皆由同一人预见。音乐节档案可查最初的场地限制和此后安排的分工。若读者在新场地发现某项选择超出了早期设想，则需要专门证据来说明变化出现何时，及哪些参与者作了决定。大型艺术活动还取决于场地之外的人员和资源，不在这条史料所能逐项覆盖的范围里。

传记阅读聚焦于华格纳怎样从无法按预期使用既有场馆，转向另找可以承载演出的做法。决定变更场地与负责造出场地也应分开。以这三个记录点，可以评估他对演出条件的取舍，读者也可以去比较一项由别人设计和执行的具体安排。档案传递的是某次将艺术考虑落实为场地选择的过程，进一步谈全部舞台观念仍要用与那些部分有关的材料。
narrative.en:
The Bayreuth Festival’s history begins this part of Wagner’s project with a constraint. He considered the existing opera house too small for the intended festival. The account then identifies Otto Brückwald as the architect of the new theater and dates the opening to 1876. The three facts refer to different activities. Assessing the existing venue identifies a problem in the setting for the work. Planning a building requires design decisions for which another person had a named responsibility. The opening dates the point the new arrangement entered use. Giving the whole project one familiar name would make it harder to establish which choices can actually be attributed to the composer.

A comparison might begin with the practical demands of the planned performances. Which needs can be shown to have been difficult to accommodate in the earlier building? What evidence identifies the way the new venue handled one of those demands? A claim about a single acoustic or staging effect should be checked against plans, a contemporary description, or a record of a performance. The existence of the new building does not show which participant anticipated every effect. The festival history establishes the initial question about suitability and the division of responsibilities that followed. It gives clues about where to look for a design change whose timing or authorship is still at issue.

FermatMind’s reading concerns Wagner’s response to the mismatch between a planned event and the means available to stage it. An existing building could be considered and set aside, opening a different course of action. The choice to pursue such a venue can be examined without ascribing the work of architectural design to the same party. These limits make the episode informative about the way an artistic plan became a decision about physical conditions. A larger study of staging would need other sources for the conduct of particular performances and contributions by their participants. Here the chronology provides a specific case in which the scale of a project became a constraint somebody had to address.
narrative.zh-TW:
拜羅伊特音樂節的歷史說明從一處具體限制講起：華格納考察當地舊歌劇院後，認為它的空間不足以舉辦想要的演出。此後採用的是另建劇院的辦法，設計工作由奧托·布呂克瓦爾德承擔，場館於1876年開放。對已有建築的判斷明確了問題，由誰作建築設計是第二項證據，開放日期標示專案進入實際使用的節點。即使整件事在後來的介紹中以作曲家名字統攝，也不應該把每項設計都寫成他本人親手繪製。

比較兩個場館，可以先問打算舉辦的場次需要什麼，由舊場地是否合適說到新場館解決哪些要求。若要說明一個具體聲學效果，最好找到圖紙、當時的說明或現場記錄。不能由新劇院建成自動推定每項效果皆由同一人預見。音樂節檔案可查最初的場地限制和此後安排的分工。若讀者在新場地發現某項選擇超出了早期設想，則需要專門證據來說明變化出現何時，及哪些參與者作了決定。大型藝術活動還取決於場地之外的人員和資源，不在這條史料所能逐項覆蓋的範圍裡。

傳記閱讀聚焦於華格納怎樣從無法按預期使用既有場館，轉向另找可以承載演出的做法。決定變更場地與負責造出場地也應分開。以這三個記錄點，可以評估他對演出條件的取捨，讀者也可以去比較一項由別人設計和執行的具體安排。檔案傳遞的是某次將藝術考慮落實為場地選擇的過程，進一步談全部舞臺觀念仍要用與那些部分有關的材料。

personalityQuestion.zh: 为何拜罗伊特的新剧院能作为解读华格纳的一条证据？
personalityQuestion.en: What makes the change of venue a useful biographical episode for Wagner?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 為何拜羅伊特的新劇院能作為解讀華格納的一條證據？

personalityAnswer.zh: 档案可查他的场地判断、建筑师的分工和新场所开放的次序。
personalityAnswer.en: The archive documents how a practical venue constraint led to a different plan, with distinct design responsibilities.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 檔案可查他的場地判斷、建築師的分工和新場所開放的次序。

narrative.zh:
1865年4月9日，罗伯特·李在阿波马托克斯致信格兰特，同意后者提出的投降条件，并说明将指定军官负责执行。美国国家公园管理局将相关文件放在一起，因此读者可以逐份检查什么由格兰特提出、什么由李确认。若只用一幅著名会晤图像来记忆投降，可能看不出双方需要交接怎样的权限。文件既明确有答复，也留下下一步由哪些层级办理的方向。指派执行意味着落实还有另外的过程，不能将接受条款的当天和其后每项办理都看成同一瞬间。

阅读时，可以先找到提议的分项和李的答复，再比对双方怎样描述负责执行的人。把这些内容同停车地点、到场时间等现场记述比较，也有助于分辨叙事和产生约束的正式文字。若研究者要描述一名士兵获准离开后的经历，应寻找他个人的记录或有关命令。总司令回复中的许诺可以给这类研究建立框架，却无法覆盖处于不同位置者的全部经历。用带日期的文件，还可以区分这次交接与别处后来发生的投降，不把一封信解释为整个战争在各地同时结束。

费马观察的是李在一个有明确条款、必须安排执行的场合怎样作出回应。读者可依据文件核对他接受了条件并表示将交给军官办理。这一选择属于指挥过程，不提供对军事目标或战争中道德责任的全面评判。若要理解某个条款为何这样制定，应再查提出一方的资料与其他协商记录。保留具体信件和角色，也让人能够对走到执行阶段的决定进行核查，而不必仅靠对人物的总体评价复述事件。
narrative.en:
On April 9, 1865, Robert E. Lee responded to Grant at Appomattox, accepted the terms of surrender, and stated that he would designate officers to carry them out. The National Park Service preserves documents through which their parts in the exchange can be checked. One person proposed terms, another replied to them, and there would be work for officers who handled their implementation. A representation of the meeting itself gives a different kind of account, about public memory or the appearance of the scene. The letters identify an acceptance and what responsibility the respondent said would follow. They give an indication of the steps that remained even after there was agreement.

A reader can compare the terms Grant offered with the language of Lee’s answer. Matching the dates and people involved establishes which documents belong to the same exchange. Another account might place someone in the room, but the accepted terms are examined more directly through the correspondence. Looking at implementation requires records at a more local level, such as the relevant orders or a participant’s account. The reply can provide a framework for such a search without supplying the experience of each person affected. Keeping the dates attached also avoids treating agreements in different places as if every part of the conflict ended by means of this one letter.

For the profile, the significant action is a response under conditions in which a choice had to be communicated formally and responsibilities had to be made clear. The source documents accepting terms and moving from that answer toward their execution. Assertions about the origins of specific provisions would call for the evidence of people involved in drafting them. An assessment of the aims of the war or of Lee’s wider responsibilities would involve different sources. The narrower reading allows someone to look closely at how an agreed action was to be carried out without letting the episode substitute for an account of the entire conflict. The dated correspondence keeps the decision available to examine apart from opinions about the people who made it.
narrative.zh-TW:
1865年4月9日，羅伯特·李在阿波馬托克斯致信格蘭特，同意後者提出的投降條件，並說明將指定軍官負責執行。美國國家公園管理局將相關檔案放在一起，因此讀者可以逐份檢查什麼由格蘭特提出、什麼由李確認。若只用一幅著名會晤影像來記憶投降，可能看不出雙方需要交接怎樣的權限。檔案既明確有答覆，也留下下一步由哪些層級辦理的方向。指派執行意味著落實還有另外的過程，不能將接受條款的當天和其後每項辦理都看成同一瞬間。

閱讀時，可以先找到提議的分項和李的答覆，再比對雙方怎樣描述負責執行的人。把這些內容同停車地點、到場時間等現場記述比較，也有助於分辨敘事和產生約束的正式文字。若研究者要描述一名士兵獲准離開後的經歷，應尋找他個人的記錄或有關命令。總司令回覆中的許諾可以給這類研究建立框架，卻無法覆蓋處於不同位置者的全部經歷。用帶日期的檔案，還可以區分這次交接與別處後來發生的投降，不把一封信解釋為整個戰爭在各地同時結束。

費馬觀察的是李在一個有明確條款、必須安排執行的場合怎樣作出回應。讀者可依據檔案核對他接受了條件並表示將交給軍官辦理。這一選擇屬於指揮過程，不提供對軍事目標或戰爭中道德責任的全面評判。若要理解某個條款為何這樣制定，應再查提出一方的資料與其他協商記錄。保留具體信件和角色，也讓人能夠對走到執行階段的決定進行核查，而不必僅靠對人物的總體評價複述事件。

personalityQuestion.zh: 李的回信除接受条件外，还做了什么安排？
personalityQuestion.en: What did Lee’s reply add to the acceptance of Grant’s terms?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 李的回信除接受條件外，還做了什麼安排？

personalityAnswer.zh: 他说明会指定军官执行，文件因此把同意条款和随后办理区别开。
personalityAnswer.en: It named the next responsibility: designating officers to carry out the terms.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 他說明會指定軍官執行，檔案因此把同意條款和隨後辦理區別開。

narrative.zh:
史密森学会所藏的1807年8月29日信使富尔顿的一项工作可以从两个时间方向阅读。他向利文斯顿报告蒸汽船初次航行，也谈到建立定期客运的计划。报告航行告诉收信者已经发生的情况，安排定期服务则说明下一阶段准备做什么。同一封信保存这两类话，不能把未来的打算全改写成已经兑现的服务记录。技术试航有特定的一程，客运面对的则是能否在一段时期持续向人提供航程。书信将两件事接到一起，便于读者追查从可行到日常使用还需要哪些证据。

核对航运史时，可以先找这次航行的报告，再用通告、时刻表或票据追查服务何时出现。若有晚些时候的记载说路线变了，也可按日期检查信里的计划是否作过调整。信中谈到未来运作，有助于理解收信人为何要尽早得到试航消息。要从这层联系推出谁负责票务、费用和后续安排等问题，还得看相关文书。试航表明技术进入一种可观察的行动，服务记录则能说明航程何时变成别人可以重复使用的安排。两份不同的材料各有用途。

费马选这个事例，是因为富尔顿把报告成果和为使用者设计下一步放进一次可定位的沟通。读者能问他向合作者报告了什么，又希望如何将已有经验转为运营。即便后续线路和信中设想有出入，也不会消除信件在那个时点呈现的计划。要评估这项实践如何影响后来交通，须把服务确实运行的证据再加入。眼下能确定的是一次试航如何被用于讨论定期载客，这比将整段历史只用一位发明者的名字概括更便于核实。
narrative.en:
The letter dated August 29, 1807 in the Smithsonian collection records two parts of Fulton’s work with Livingston. It describes a first voyage and discusses plans for a regular passenger service. Reporting a trip gives an account of something that had happened. Proposing service concerns an arrangement the author wanted people to be able to use in the future. Both can appear in the same letter without providing the same evidence. A trip establishes a particular occasion on which a vessel moved. A service offered over time calls for a repeatable arrangement. The letter allows a reader to see that both matters were in view when Fulton reported to his collaborator.

To follow the later development, begin by identifying what the letter says about the voyage. Then consult notices, schedules, or passenger records for the beginning of a service. If the route later changed, the dates of those records would provide a way to see how practice diverged from the earlier plan. The letter explains why somebody might tell a collaborator about the immediate result and the next question in one communication. It cannot assign responsibility for every later decision about buying tickets or organizing departures. Reports and service documents distinguish an observed trial from the stages at which people were able to rely on a journey more than once.

The biographical reading considers the decision to connect a demonstrated result to a proposal for its continued use. Fulton’s choice of what to report and what to outline can be seen in a document with a named recipient and a date. Confirmation of the plan’s later success depends on different evidence. Its subsequent alteration would also be a result to investigate, rather than a reason to ignore what the letter planned at the time. The source thus makes it possible to discuss a specific move between visible technical performance and passenger operations. It supplies a better line of inquiry into collaboration than a general statement about invention and leaves space to document who took decisions as the service developed.
narrative.zh-TW:
史密森學會所藏的1807年8月29日信使富爾頓的一項工作可以從兩個時間方向閱讀。他向利文斯頓報告蒸汽船初次航行，也談到建立定期客運的計劃。報告航行告訴收信者已經發生的情況，安排定期服務則說明下一階段準備做什麼。同一封信保存這兩類話，不能把未來的打算全改寫成已經兌現的服務記錄。技術試航有特定的一程，客運面對的則是能否在一段時期持續向人提供航程。書信將兩件事接到一起，便於讀者追查從可行到日常使用還需要哪些證據。

核對航運史時，可以先找這次航行的報告，再用通告、時刻表或票據追查服務何時出現。若有晚些時候的記載說路線變了，也可按日期檢查信裡的計劃是否作過調整。信中談到未來運作，有助於理解收信人為何要儘早得到試航訊息。要從這層聯絡推出誰負責票務、費用和後續安排等問題，還得看相關文書。試航表明技術進入一種可觀察的行動，服務記錄則能說明航程何時變成別人可以重複使用的安排。兩份不同的材料各有用途。

費馬選這個事例，是因為富爾頓把報告成果和為使用者設計下一步放進一次可定位的溝通。讀者能問他向合作者報告了什麼，又希望如何將已有經驗轉為運營。即便後續線路和信中設想有出入，也不會消除信件在那個時點呈現的計劃。要評估這項實踐如何影響後來交通，須把服務確實執行的證據再加入。眼下能確定的是一次試航如何被用於討論定期載客，這比將整段歷史只用一位發明者的名字概括更便於核實。

personalityQuestion.zh: 富尔顿为什么在同一封信里写了首航和定期客运？
personalityQuestion.en: What is the significance of discussing regular service together with the first voyage?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 富爾頓為什麼在同一封信裡寫了首航和定期客運？

personalityAnswer.zh: 他把已完成的航行报告接到下一步使用方案。是否按计划运营需要另查。
personalityAnswer.en: The letter links a demonstrated trip to an arrangement proposed for continued use.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 他把已完成的航行報告接到下一步使用方案。是否按計劃運營需要另查。

narrative.zh:
英国政府的传记记载，沃波尔在1735年迁入唐宁街10号之前，坚持将这所房子作为第一财政大臣的官邸。看似是接受一处住处，细节却给接受方式增加了一项制度条件。人离职以后仍可保有私人财产，随职位而用的住处则能给后任继续使用。将两者分开，才看得见这项安排除了满足当前居住之外，还涉及以后谁可以用同一个地点。政府传记给它一个明确职位，至于房屋如何具体管理、历任使用有无中断，则是需要逐次追查的问题。

史料可按拟议的用途、实际迁入和后来使用三步整理。若档案涉及这处房产，先看它讨论的是所有权、使用权还是某位人物生活中的一段日期。三个问题未必由同一份记录回答。例如，查到后来有另一位官员住进去，可以作为实际使用的资料，仍不能由此证明前任已预料此后形成的所有惯例。对一项官邸安排的影响，可以比较后继记录是否仍然用相同的职务名称。说明来源为何使用这一称谓，也能避免把今日熟悉的头衔直接送回当时的每一项行为。

这份人物档案从沃波尔把一项眼前利益同持续存在的职位联系起来的选择作解读。可查的是在接受住处时，他坚持使用安排附于特定职务。相比泛称他有制度意识，详细说出职位和日期更容易通过其他记录检验。即使别处还可找到私人因素，明确的条件仍能够作为一条独立线索。理解官邸后来成为怎样的象征，可以再找不同时期访客、官员或房产档案。该传记先固定一项当时可以确认的约定，再让它与后来的用法对话。
narrative.en:
The UK government biography records that Walpole insisted that 10 Downing Street be used as the official residence of the First Lord of the Treasury before moving in during 1735. Accepting a place to live can look like the same action regardless of the terms. An attachment to an office changes who can make use of a property after the first occupant leaves. That is the point the biography makes visible. The source gives the condition and associates it with a particular office. Details of how the property was managed thereafter, including any interruptions in use, depend on records of later occupants and decisions rather than on the statement of the initial arrangement alone.

One can follow a proposal for use, the actual move, and later occupancy as separate subjects. A document about ownership can answer a different question from a document about who could live there. Later records identifying another user offer evidence of what happened beyond Walpole. They do not establish all the expectations he held when he accepted the house. Comparing the terminology of each record helps avoid putting a familiar modern title into every event in which it would now be tempting to use it.

The action used in the biographical reading is connecting an immediate opportunity with an office that could continue through other occupants. A specific condition placed on official use can be checked alongside the date of the move. It provides evidence about the way the decision was formulated, even if another source gives a different account of associated motives. The durable public meaning of the residence can then be studied using records from the periods in which it acquired that meaning. The current profile begins with the identifiable decision about use and keeps the separate question of how it was carried forward open to further evidence. That makes the episode more informative than a general assertion about Walpole’s grasp of institutions.
narrative.zh-TW:
英國政府的傳記記載，沃波爾在1735年遷入唐寧街10號之前，堅持將這所房子作為第一財政大臣的官邸。看似是接受一處住處，細節卻給接受方式增加了一項制度條件。人離職以後仍可保有私人財產，隨職位而用的住處則能給後任繼續使用。將兩者分開，才看得見這項安排除了滿足當前居住之外，還涉及以後誰可以用同一個地點。政府傳記給它一個明確職位，至於房屋如何具體管理、歷任使用有無中斷，則是需要逐次追查的問題。

史料可按擬議的用途、實際遷入和後來使用三步整理。若檔案涉及這處房產，先看它討論的是所有權、使用權還是某位人物生活中的一段日期。三個問題未必由同一份記錄回答。例如，查到後來有另一位官員住進去，可以作為實際使用的資料，仍不能由此證明前任已預料此後形成的所有慣例。對一項官邸安排的影響，可以比較後繼記錄是否仍然用相同的職務名稱。說明來源為何使用這一稱謂，也能避免把今日熟悉的頭銜直接送回當時的每一項行為。

這份人物檔案從沃波爾把一項眼前利益同持續存在的職位聯絡起來的選擇作解讀。可查的是在接受住處時，他堅持使用安排附於特定職務。相比泛稱他有制度意識，詳細說出職位和日期更容易通過其他記錄檢驗。即使別處還可找到私人因素，明確的條件仍能夠作為一條獨立線索。理解官邸後來成為怎樣的象徵，可以再找不同時期訪客、官員或房產檔案。該傳記先固定一項當時可以確認的約定，再讓它與後來的用法對話。

personalityQuestion.zh: 沃波尔迁入唐宁街10号前，为日后使用留下了什么条件？
personalityQuestion.en: What condition did Walpole place on the use of 10 Downing Street?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 沃波爾遷入唐寧街10號前，為日後使用留下了什麼條件？

personalityAnswer.zh: 他坚持让房子服务于第一财政大臣这一职务，而非只作为他的个人住处。
personalityAnswer.en: It was to be the official residence of the First Lord of the Treasury.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 他堅持讓房子服務於第一財政大臣這一職務，而非只作為他的個人住處。

narrative.zh:
克拉克将牛顿的《光学》译成拉丁文，斯坦福哲学百科把译本刊行定在1706年，并把这项工作与他和牛顿正式建立联系并列叙述。换一种语言会让同一项论证接触新的读者，也给译者留下逐处解释术语的任务。作者提供的概念、译文使用的词和校订中能够确认的参与，不能一律看作同一个人单独完成。该资料使人可以确认所涉作品、语言和时间。读者若要判断一个概念究竟怎样进入译文，还需要打开具体的两种版本面对面比较。

从一个描述仪器或现象的段落入手，可以记下英文词在原文的任务，再核对拉丁文本是否保持相同的关系。若两种说法在阅读中引出不同联想，有必要区分是语言结构造成的差异，还是版本改过了原先的内容。也可能需要找出作者和译者之间的文字往来，才能确认有一处取舍究竟由谁提出。出版年份可以让版本比较有顺序，不能代替对每项用语变化的历史说明。翻译受到读者关注的程度，则要另从引用、评论和典藏情况追查。

在传记档案里，费马关注克拉克如何在原作和另一群读者之间承担知识传递的职责。拉丁译本给出的线索是他使可以读另一种语言的人接触到一部已经存在的论著，至于能否在另一些领域也采用类似做法，需要找到别的译作或书信。任何对细部用语的判断都可以重新交回原文核对，这使这次协作成为有较清楚边界的观察对象。它并不是一张涵盖克拉克全部哲学立场的标签，首先是一次能够从作品和时间追查的实际活动。
narrative.en:
The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy dates Clarke’s Latin translation of Newton’s Opticks to 1706. Its biography treats this work as the occasion on which his association with Newton became formal. Translation puts an existing argument in a form people who read another language can consult. In doing so it gives the translator a job at the level of particular terms and relationships. The contribution of the original author, wording chosen in the translation, and decisions for which collaboration is documented need to be identified separately. The biography establishes the work, language, and date. It gives a starting point for comparing versions when a reader wants to account for an individual expression.

Begin with a passage describing an apparatus or a phenomenon. Identify what an expression does in the English, then look for how the Latin conveys that relation. A difference can arise from choices involving grammar or from the editions having a different wording to begin with. To attribute a change to one named person, a reader might need correspondence or another record of how the translation was prepared. Dating the publication establishes an order for comparison but does not explain every choice. A claim about particular readers subsequently using the translation would also require some account of the copies they read, quoted, or discussed.

The part of the episode used in the profile is Clarke’s work in bringing a defined text between communities of readers. Because both the source work and a translation have names and dates, a biographical interpretation can stay close to a particular act. A comparison could show whether something established in the English became difficult to preserve in Latin. It could equally show that a relation is maintained in another form. Similar work elsewhere in Clarke’s career would need its own documents before being used to generalize. The episode already makes it possible to discuss collaboration and transmission without inferring the translator’s whole philosophical position from a choice that can be inspected passage by passage.
narrative.zh-TW:
克拉克將牛頓的《光學》譯成拉丁文，斯坦福哲學百科把譯本刊行定在1706年，並把這項工作與他和牛頓正式建立聯絡並列敘述。換一種語言會讓同一項論證接觸新的讀者，也給譯者留下逐處解釋術語的任務。作者提供的概念、譯文使用的詞和校訂中能夠確認的參與，不能一律看作同一個人單獨完成。該資料使人可以確認所涉作品、語言和時間。讀者若要判斷一個概念究竟怎樣進入譯文，還需要開啟具體的兩種版本面對面比較。

從一個描述儀器或現象的段落入手，可以記下英文詞在原文的任務，再核對拉丁文本是否保持相同的關係。若兩種說法在閱讀中引出不同聯想，有必要區分是語言結構造成的差異，還是版本改過了原先的內容。也可能需要找出作者和譯者之間的文字往來，才能確認有一處取捨究竟由誰提出。出版年份可以讓版本比較有順序，不能代替對每項用語變化的歷史說明。翻譯受到讀者關注的程度，則要另從引用、評論和典藏情況追查。

在傳記檔案裡，費馬關注克拉克如何在原作和另一群讀者之間承擔知識傳遞的職責。拉丁譯本給出的線索是他使可以讀另一種語言的人接觸到一部已經存在的論著，至於能否在另一些領域也採用類似做法，需要找到別的譯作或書信。任何對細部用語的判斷都可以重新交回原文核對，這使這次協作成為有較清楚邊界的觀察對象。它並不是一張涵蓋克拉克全部哲學立場的標籤，首先是一次能夠從作品和時間追查的實際活動。

personalityQuestion.zh: 克拉克的拉丁版《光学》如何成为可核的协作线索？
personalityQuestion.en: How can the Latin Opticks anchor a biographical account of Clarke’s collaboration?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 克拉克的拉丁版《光學》如何成為可核的協作線索？

personalityAnswer.zh: 年份、作品和语言都可查，具体译词可比较版本并按材料核对归属。
personalityAnswer.en: The dated translation identifies the work, while comparisons can test individual choices of wording.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 年份、作品和語言都可查，具體譯詞可比較版本並按材料核對歸屬。

narrative.zh:
哈佛霍顿图书馆展示了为强森编词典而抄录的莎士比亚引文。展品让人看到一项通常藏在词条后面的工作：先从实际文本中找词的用法，再决定它可以说明哪个义项。引文既是作家的句子，也是编纂工作重新索引过的材料。若读者只看到后来印本里的简短释义，就容易以为那是编者自己规定的意思。将抄录页和词条并看，则能检查哪些说法有使用实例支撑，也能注意部分实例可能没有进入最后的印本。一个工作页因此有别于完整词典的读法。

实际核对可以从一段抄录文字开始。辨认它来自哪部作品、谁在何种处境说出那句话，再查词典把它放在哪个词下。如果一则引句在词典中缩短，试着恢复前一句或后一句，看删掉的环境是否改变这项用法给人的印象。若一个词有多种用法，引文也不是看起来都相似就证明可以合作一个意思。它只显示这个作者在某处如何使用。哈佛说明可以核实确有为词典准备的抄录工作，将多处材料划入义项仍应按有关词条逐一研究。

费马用这件事讨论他如何将可见的使用实例变为可以随条目检查的依据。读者看到的不只是名家身份入了选，还能问选了什么话、用来说明什么。若批评他的材料过度依赖某类作家或写法，可以据具体用例提出不同分析，而不必泛谈他是否可靠。将一位作者的贡献和整个编纂过程分开，也能承认还有别的读者、抄录者或编辑活动需要追踪。这一处有实物可找的工作材料，给传记观察留下了较稳的边界。
narrative.en:
Harvard’s Houghton Library exhibits Shakespeare quotations transcribed for Johnson’s dictionary. The item shows a task that can be difficult to see behind a finished definition. A particular use has to be found in a text and made available for consideration under a word. The passage remains something a writer once put into a work. The act of transcription also places it inside a separate editorial inquiry. Seeing only a brief definition in the published dictionary can conceal this step. With a working transcription, a reader can ask which uses became evidence for an entry and whether an example selected for consideration appears in the final printing. The object is therefore useful for studying preparation, not just the finished result.

Begin with a transcribed passage and establish where it occurs. Read the speaker and situation in Shakespeare, then check which term or sense is at issue in the dictionary. If the quotation is shorter in print, restoring the adjoining sentence can show what an excerpt leaves behind. When a word has several uses, a quotation supports an instance of a use, and a reader can ask what qualifies it to stand with other cases. The surviving item documents that instances were gathered for this project. A claim about their final classification should identify the entries and editions that would allow the decision to be checked. Differences between working material and print are a subject of investigation in their own right.

FermatMind examines the choice to turn observed language into evidence a reader might recognize at the level of a particular entry. The usefulness of a quotation is separate from the prestige of the author who supplied it. It depends on what the passage shows and which claim the editor wants it to support. A critic can return to the same words and question whether they illustrate the selected sense, or supply other instances from texts that were not consulted. The library’s item gives such a disagreement a concrete starting point. It does not describe every contribution by other people who helped prepare a large reference work. It makes one kind of working decision accessible to the person reading a finished page.
narrative.zh-TW:
哈佛霍頓圖書館展示了為強森編詞典而抄錄的莎士比亞引文。展品讓人看到一項通常藏在詞條後面的工作：先從實際文本中找詞的用法，再決定它可以說明哪個義項。引文既是作家的句子，也是編纂工作重新索引過的材料。若讀者只看到後來印本里的簡短釋義，就容易以為那是編者自己規定的意思。將抄錄頁和詞條並看，則能檢查哪些說法有使用例項支撐，也能注意部分例項可能沒有進入最後的印本。一個工作頁因此有別於完整詞典的讀法。

實際核對可以從一段抄錄文字開始。辨認它來自哪部作品、誰在何種處境說出那句話，再查詞典把它放在哪個詞下。如果一則引句在詞典中縮短，試著恢復前一句或後一句，看刪掉的環境是否改變這項用法給人的印象。若一個詞有多種用法，引文也不是看起來都相似就證明可以合作一個意思。它只顯示這個作者在某處如何使用。哈佛說明可以核實確有為詞典準備的抄錄工作，將多處材料劃入義項仍應按有關詞條逐一研究。

費馬用這件事討論他如何將可見的使用例項變為可以隨條目檢查的依據。讀者看到的不只是名家身份入了選，還能問選了什麼話、用來說明什麼。若批評他的材料過度依賴某類作家或寫法，可以據具體用例提出不同分析，而不必泛談他是否可靠。將一位作者的貢獻和整個編纂過程分開，也能承認還有別的讀者、抄錄者或編輯活動需要追蹤。這一處有實物可找的工作材料，給傳記觀察留下了較穩的邊界。

personalityQuestion.zh: 强森为词典抄录莎士比亚，费马从哪一步理解他的工作方式？
personalityQuestion.en: Why are the Shakespeare transcriptions pertinent to Johnson’s profile?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 強森為詞典抄錄莎士比亞，費馬從哪一步理解他的工作方式？

personalityAnswer.zh: 可以从实际用例追到词条，核对编者如何选择材料和说明义项。
personalityAnswer.en: They allow a comparison between examples gathered from use and the entries they could support.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 可以從實際用例追到詞條，核對編者如何選擇材料和說明義項。

narrative.zh:
《古舟子咏》第一部分起手便让舟子拦住一个正去参加婚礼的人。文库本可回查这个人有别的去处，也可确认海上故事是从打断进入，而不是从船已经离港开始。这个开场让读者在听见故事前先认识一个未主动来听的人。婚礼的时间和现场的期待还在近处，舟子的话却要求他改换注意。作者用场景把能否使人停下来听变成叙事的一部分。如只摘出航程中的异象，很容易把这种开场处理从全诗的阅读经验里移除。

可在每次叙事回到婚礼宾客处时记下一笔。注意这一回是宾客说了什么，还是诗只让读者重新想起他在场。再检查被讲述的事件和倾听者的反应如何配合。若要说明1798年初刊和所见校订本的某一行完全相同，还应核对不同版本，不能让文库的初刊年份代替文本校勘。文学上的倾听也不必被写成现实中的听众一律接受了故事。此处能明确的是作品安排了一种带有阻力的听法。实际读者怎样评论开头，要另看他们留下的文字。

费马用这一可读的开场讨论柯勒律治如何给故事设置传递条件。其写法可以使人觉得被打断、被要求倾听，或对叙述资格产生疑问。不同理解都可从第一部分同一个接触点开始比较。诗中宾客和舟子属于作者安排的角色，由角色的行为不能直推诗人的日常说话方式。若希望把这种以打断引入叙事的手法延伸到其他诗，可以再找另一处结构明确的开场。这里已经有充足的依据说明为什么眼前这一个开场让听故事本身成为要观察的行动。
narrative.en:
In Part I of The Rime of the Ancient Mariner, a man on his way to a wedding is stopped and made to hear a voyage recounted. The text gives the listener somewhere he was already going. The story of the sea begins by interrupting that intention instead of opening directly aboard a ship. Readers meet someone who did not arrive looking for this tale before they enter the narrative he is given. Extracting a striking event from the voyage can leave out the way the poem first made the activity of listening an issue of its own. The open edition gives a location where that framing can be examined.

One can mark each return to the wedding guest and ask what kind of attention the text records there. At other moments a reference may simply remind the reader of the situation in which the story is being told. Comparing a return with the episode that precedes it can show whether the interruption still shapes the experience of the account. The record of first publication in Lyrical Ballads in 1798 is useful for orientation. A statement about the wording of a particular line at that date would still require a comparison with an appropriate edition. 

The profile examines how Coleridge prepared the conditions under which a story could be heard. The narrative begins with a listener who has a prior obligation and whose attention has to be redirected. Readers may interpret that meeting as coercive, compelling, or disquieting, and the source lets them identify which parts of the opening bear on their interpretation. This concerns roles within an arranged poem. It does not offer biographical evidence that the poet conducted ordinary conversations like one of his characters. The immediate evidence is the opening itself, which places the activity of listening where a reader cannot treat it merely as a neutral route to the voyage.
narrative.zh-TW:
《古舟子詠》第一部分起手便讓舟子攔住一個正去參加婚禮的人。文庫本可回查這個人有別的去處，也可確認海上故事是從打斷進入，而不是從船已經離港開始。這個開場讓讀者在聽見故事前先認識一個未主動來聽的人。婚禮的時間和現場的期待還在近處，舟子的話卻要求他改換注意。作者用場景把能否使人停下來聽變成敘事的一部分。如只摘出航程中的異象，很容易把這種開場處理從全詩的閱讀經驗裡移除。

可在每次敘事回到婚禮賓客處時記下一筆。注意這一回是賓客說了什麼，還是詩只讓讀者重新想起他在場。再檢查被講述的事件和傾聽者的反應如何配合。若要說明1798年初刊和所見校訂本的某一行完全相同，還應核對不同版本，不能讓文庫的初刊年份代替文本校勘。文學上的傾聽也不必被寫成現實中的聽眾一律接受了故事。此處能明確的是作品安排了一種帶有阻力的聽法。實際讀者怎樣評論開頭，要另看他們留下的文字。

費馬用這一可讀的開場討論柯勒律治如何給故事設定傳遞條件。其寫法可以使人覺得被打斷、被要求傾聽，或對敘述資格產生疑問。不同理解都可從第一部分同一個接觸點開始比較。詩中賓客和舟子屬於作者安排的角色，由角色的行為不能直推詩人的日常說話方式。若希望把這種以打斷引入敘事的手法延伸到其他詩，可以再找另一處結構明確的開場。這裡已經有充足的依據說明為什麼眼前這一個開場讓聽故事本身成為要觀察的行動。

personalityQuestion.zh: 婚礼宾客为什么是这首诗的开场关键？
personalityQuestion.en: Why does the listener’s destination matter to Coleridge’s opening?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 婚禮賓客為什麼是這首詩的開場關鍵？

personalityAnswer.zh: 他原有别的去处，舟子的叙述必须先改变他的注意与行动。
personalityAnswer.en: The guest has somewhere else to go, so the telling begins as an interruption.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 他原有別的去處，舟子的敘述必須先改變他的注意與行動。

narrative.zh:
教科文组织将《牙买加书简》定在1815年9月6日，说明它回复亨利·卡伦，并拟交给金斯敦的报纸。写信对象和预想发表地点同时出现，给这份文字两种不同的听众。收信人有自己提出的问题，读报人却未必接触过来信原文。玻利瓦在回复中怎样介绍问题、何处为新的读者交代背景，由此成为可以实际检查的写作选择。认得一位私人收信人，并不表示内容只适合两人之间传阅。要知道报纸后来是否怎样刊登，则须找到当期报纸或相应档案。

若要了解文字面向哪些讨论，可先核对原先问了什么，再读回复里怎样展开一个跨地区的政治局势。对局部情况的陈述、给出一般解释和预期以后会发生的事情，都应在写下的日期内理解。若将它同后来的公开演讲比较，要给各自的听众和地址另留位置，不要把致卡伦的文字当成作者身处另一场合时说过的直接发言。教科文组织的条目能核实所答的来信与文本本身。是否按原设想到达读者，不能由拟交报纸这一事实直接推出。

费马由此分析玻利瓦怎样利用明确的通信关系提出面向较大范围读者的问题。作品不必只按一封普通私信来读，也不宜被描述成已经得到每位预想中读者回应的声明。先讲清卡伦与金斯敦报纸的不同角色，可以进一步追踪文中某句话究竟是在答问、说明背景，还是向预期的公众解释行动。具体定位使这种传记观察不只是对其影响力的称赞。作者日后政治行为和该信发表后造成的影响，仍按其他材料核对。
narrative.en:
UNESCO’s entry dates Bolívar’s Jamaica Letter to September 6, 1815. It identifies Henry Cullen as the person whose letter he answered and says that the reply was intended for a Kingston newspaper. A named correspondent and a possible newspaper audience create different conditions for explanation. Cullen had asked a question. A reader coming to a newspaper might know nothing of the private inquiry that preceded the reply. That difference gives a reader a reason to inspect the way the text introduces its subject and supplies context. Knowing the identity of a named correspondent does not by itself settle who the writer expected to read the work. Evidence of actual printing or circulation would need to come from a further record.

Begin by distinguishing the question answered from the broader affairs the reply brings into view. Some passages may report what the writer believed was happening. Others may propose an explanation or state an expectation about events to come. Dating those statements helps a reader avoid taking a prediction as proof that a result was already established. A public address at another time may give useful terms of comparison if its audience and circumstances are kept visible. The UNESCO entry establishes the connection to Cullen and the intended newspaper. It gives an appropriate starting point for investigating how a private inquiry could lead to a form of public argument.

The biographical choice considered is using a reply to a named reader to address questions that could matter to a wider public. That choice can be examined at the level of a transition in the letter: where does an answer to the correspondent become an explanation somebody outside the exchange could follow? Readers can trace the distinction without claiming that every intended reader saw the text or took the same message from it. Reports of such responses would have value of their own. Here the historical detail about two reading situations is an opportunity to examine the form of a political communication and locate the actual decisions that shaped it.
narrative.zh-TW:
教科文組織將《牙買加書簡》定在1815年9月6日，說明它回覆亨利·卡倫，並擬交給金斯敦的報紙。寫信對象和預想發表地點同時出現，給這份文字兩種不同的聽眾。收信人有自己提出的問題，讀報人卻未必接觸過來信原文。玻利瓦在回覆中怎樣介紹問題、何處為新的讀者交代背景，由此成為可以實際檢查的寫作選擇。認得一位私人收信人，並不表示內容只適合兩人之間傳閱。要知道報紙後來是否怎樣刊登，則須找到當期報紙或相應檔案。

若要了解文字面向哪些討論，可先核對原先問了什麼，再讀回覆裡怎樣展開一個跨地區的政治局勢。對局部情況的陳述、給出一般解釋和預期以後會發生的事情，都應在寫下的日期內理解。若將它同後來的公開演講比較，要給各自的聽眾和地址另留位置，不要把致卡倫的文字當成作者身處另一場合時說過的直接發言。教科文組織的條目能核實所答的來信與文本本身。是否按原設想到達讀者，不能由擬交報紙這一事實直接推出。

費馬由此分析玻利瓦怎樣利用明確的通訊關係提出面向較大範圍讀者的問題。作品不必只按一封普通私信來讀，也不宜被描述成已經得到每位預想中讀者回應的宣告。先講清卡倫與金斯敦報紙的不同角色，可以進一步追蹤文中某句話究竟是在答問、說明背景，還是向預期的公眾解釋行動。具體定位使這種傳記觀察不只是對其影響力的稱讚。作者日後政治行為和該信發表後造成的影響，仍按其他材料核對。

personalityQuestion.zh: 玻利瓦给卡伦回信，为什么还要留意金斯敦报纸？
personalityQuestion.en: Why does the Kingston newspaper matter to a reading of Bolívar’s reply to Cullen?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 玻利瓦給卡倫回信，為什麼還要留意金斯敦報紙？

personalityAnswer.zh: 预想的报纸读者可能没看过来信，这让人能检查回复如何另行交代背景。
personalityAnswer.en: The intended readership gives a reason to examine how a private answer was made accessible to other readers.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 預想的報紙讀者可能沒看過來信，這讓人能檢查回復如何另行交代背景。

narrative.zh:
贝札的新约译本把拉丁译文与解释译法的注释一起交给读者。早期馆藏著录让人能够分辨这是把经文译成另一种语言的活动，也是一项使取舍可见的编辑实践。译文规定本页怎么读，注释则能交代某个词为何如此处理。有时熟悉两种语言的读者会认为另一个译词更合适。如果有注释，还可以把分歧定位到选择背后的理由，而不只是对译者的掌握程度作总评。一本书同时照顾连贯的阅读与逐处审视，这两种用途可以一起发生，又各有要核的部分。

做版本比较时，可选一处意义有歧义的句子，先确认所见是何年印本，再记下经文位置、拉丁用语与旁边有无评论。若注释援引希腊文本，读者可以核对它谈的是一本具体见证、词义，还是句子本身如何理解。后来印本即便采用同名著作，也可能新增或调整说明。要主张贝札从某年起更改了处理，需要有两个彼此可比较的文本。馆藏能为版本和注释形式作证，不能单凭一项书目信息填补每一处文字变化。研究谁实际采用相关译法，则要查他处引用。

在传记里，这项材料开出的问题是：贝札如何让读者检查本可隐在译文背后的决定。放入注释后，读者可问是在什么位置改变读法，有怎样的解释可以检查，哪一步仍会产生争议。不同读者接受译文的程度不必一律设想相同。费马只借这项编辑活动讨论他怎样使自己对文本的判断便于追索，并不由此替他归纳所有神学立场。能找到另一个年份和相同的经文位置，才适宜再把该线索推向更完整的版本史。
narrative.en:
Beza’s New Testament translation gives readers a Latin text together with annotations on interpretation. A catalogue of an early edition can establish that these two kinds of work were presented together. A translation determines what a reader encounters in the continuous text. An annotation can give a place to look for a reason a particular expression took that form. Where someone familiar with both languages would choose another wording, the accompanying note makes it possible to check whether the disagreement concerns the meaning of a term or the explanation for preferring one rendering. The combination therefore serves both the activity of reading and the opportunity to inspect a decision more closely.

For a comparison, choose a passage whose wording leaves open different possibilities and establish which edition is in use. Then record the location, the Latin expression, and any note printed beside it or keyed to its place. A reference to Greek may bear on a particular textual witness, the range of a word, or the construction of a sentence. These issues should be separated before a comparison is made. A later edition under the same title might contain an added or altered explanation. To date a change, the reader needs two appropriate texts, not the presence of matching titles alone. The catalogue gives evidence of publication and a form of annotation. A particular textual change will call for the versions that actually allow it to be inspected.

The action examined for the profile is making certain decisions about language available to someone besides the translator. The addition of explanations can let a careful reader point to a passage and ask why it has been rendered this way. A further comparison may show an alternative that both editions leave available, or a choice that changed over time. Such observations are more precise than treating an identifiable publishing project as evidence of the author’s entire theology. The combination of translation and notes is itself a visible way of organizing two different jobs in a book, and the historical record lets the profile examine that choice without specifying undocumented alterations.
narrative.zh-TW:
貝札的新約譯本把拉丁譯文與解釋譯法的註釋一起交給讀者。早期館藏著錄讓人能夠分辨這是把經文譯成另一種語言的活動，也是一項使取捨可見的編輯實踐。譯文規定本頁怎麼讀，註釋則能交代某個詞為何如此處理。有時熟悉兩種語言的讀者會認為另一個譯詞更合適。如果有註釋，還可以把分歧定位到選擇背後的理由，而不只是對譯者的掌握程度作總評。一本書同時照顧連貫的閱讀與逐處審視，這兩種用途可以一起發生，又各有要核的部分。

做版本比較時，可選一處意義有歧義的句子，先確認所見是何年印本，再記下經文位置、拉丁用語與旁邊有無評論。若註釋援引希臘文本，讀者可以核對它談的是一本具體見證、詞義，還是句子本身如何理解。後來印本即便採用同名著作，也可能新增或調整說明。要主張貝札從某年起更改了處理，需要有兩個彼此可比較的文本。館藏能為版本和註釋形式作證，不能單憑一項書目資訊填補每一處文字變化。研究誰實際採用相關譯法，則要查他處引用。

在傳記裡，這項材料開出的問題是：貝札如何讓讀者檢查本可隱在譯文背後的決定。放入註釋後，讀者可問是在什麼位置改變讀法，有怎樣的解釋可以檢查，哪一步仍會產生爭議。不同讀者接受譯文的程度不必一律設想相同。費馬只借這項編輯活動討論他怎樣使自己對文本的判斷便於追索，並不由此替他歸納所有神學立場。能找到另一個年份和相同的經文位置，才適宜再把該線索推向更完整的版本史。

personalityQuestion.zh: 贝札为什么让译文旁边保留注释？
personalityQuestion.en: What do the notes let readers check in Beza’s work as a translator?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 貝札為什麼讓譯文旁邊保留註釋？

personalityAnswer.zh: 经文有连续读法，注释让读者另行核查局部译法和取舍理由。
personalityAnswer.en: They give readers a way to investigate particular interpretive choices alongside the translated text.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 經文有連續讀法，註釋讓讀者另行核查局部譯法和取捨理由。

narrative.zh:
英国议会的收藏说明把克兰麦编拟公祷书，同要求按该书举行礼拜的法律分开叙述。1549年的用书要求和1552年启用修订本，也属于不同节点。这给读者一个好处：可以先确认他在哪一部分主要从事写作，再看文本如何通过制度安排影响不同地区的实践。若把所有内容当成克兰麦一次个人命令，就会混淆编书、立法和当地落实。议会说明能够为各阶段提供日期。地方究竟如何应对，还需查相应教区或同时代记录。

选一个新旧版本之间可辨认的段落，对照它在什么位置，主持者或会众需要做什么。修改措辞和改变实行办法相关，却不完全相同。问题若是某一句由谁提出，就找有证据归属的书稿，若是新文本何时产生规范效果，则找法规和颁布日期。若有人把后来的统一法案当作1549年同一份文件，应从版本和年份两个方向检查。读者也能由此追问是否所有人实际采纳了新做法，避免将纸面一定要做的事情直接等同于一处教堂已经做过的事。

费马在这段历史取用的是克兰麦参与将仪式安排写成可协调的文本。共用文本允许不同地方的人核对自己面对的是哪一套措辞，因此比回顾几句概括性形容更接近他的实际工作。该解释不会归给他之后阶段的所有行动，也不认为制度效应都由编书者自己控制。如果找到一项具体校订，还可以讨论它如何改变另一位使用者面对的文字和要求。页面把成书、启用及修订同时留在时间线上，给传记观察明确的动作和边界。
narrative.en:
The UK Parliament description credits Thomas Cranmer with drafting the prayer book and distinguishes the act enforcing use of the 1549 book from the introduction of the revised book in 1552. The literary, legislative, and practical stages can therefore be examined separately. Preparing wording suitable for common use is one kind of responsibility. Deciding that a text is to govern practice is another. The timing of actual adoption in a locality would present still another question. A description that attributes the whole sequence to one command from Cranmer would make those stages hard to see. The parliamentary record gives dates for identifying them before other material is used to study what happened in a place.

A comparison can start with a passage appearing in both books. Note where it is placed, who is expected to act at that point, and whether the newer version changes a task or wording. Manuscript evidence may help identify who proposed a change in phrasing. A statute or related document is better suited to showing what took effect and when. Where two accounts refer to an act or a prayer book without naming a year, identifying the correct version can prevent the text of one change from being carried over to another. Evidence of how a congregation responded has to be located rather than assumed from the prescription. 

The activity considered in the profile is Cranmer’s part in giving a practice a form that could be referred to by different people. A shared text makes an arrangement available for discussion and comparison in different locations. That does not put the author in control of every later stage, including how authorities used legislation or how people responded. If a change can be tied to a specific passage, one can examine how it altered what a user would encounter. The sequence of drafting, introduction, and revision provides a useful setting for that narrower biographical inquiry. It also preserves the difference between a statement about Cranmer’s work and a statement about the effect of a law.
narrative.zh-TW:
英國議會的收藏說明把克蘭麥編擬公禱書，同要求按該書舉行禮拜的法律分開敘述。1549年的用書要求和1552年啟用修訂本，也屬於不同節點。這給讀者一個好處：可以先確認他在哪一部分主要從事寫作，再看文本如何通過制度安排影響不同地區的實踐。若把所有內容當成克蘭麥一次個人命令，就會混淆編書、立法和當地落實。議會說明能夠為各階段提供日期。地方究竟如何應對，還需查相應教區或同時代記錄。

選一個新舊版本之間可辨認的段落，對照它在什麼位置，主持者或會眾需要做什麼。修改措辭和改變實行辦法相關，卻不完全相同。問題若是某一句由誰提出，就找有證據歸屬的書稿，若是新文本何時產生規範效果，則找法規和頒佈日期。若有人把後來的統一法案當作1549年同一份檔案，應從版本和年份兩個方向檢查。讀者也能由此追問是否所有人實際採納了新做法，避免將紙面一定要做的事情直接等同於一處教堂已經做過的事。

費馬在這段歷史取用的是克蘭麥參與將儀式安排寫成可協調的文本。共用文本允許不同地方的人核對自己面對的是哪一套措辭，因此比回顧幾句概括性形容更接近他的實際工作。該解釋不會歸給他之後階段的所有行動，也不認為制度效應都由編書者自己控制。如果找到一項具體校訂，還可以討論它如何改變另一位使用者面對的文字和要求。頁面把成書、啟用及修訂同時留在時間線上，給傳記觀察明確的動作和邊界。

personalityQuestion.zh: 为什么克兰麦编公祷书和议会要求使用它要分开描述？
personalityQuestion.en: Why distinguish Cranmer’s drafting from Parliament’s enforcement of the prayer book?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 為什麼克蘭麥編公禱書和議會要求使用它要分開描述？

personalityAnswer.zh: 文本给出共同使用的措辞，法律决定何时要求采用。两项行动由不同记录支持。
personalityAnswer.en: The text and the enforcement record document different decisions concerning a shared practice.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 文本給出共同使用的措辭，法律決定何時要求採用。兩項行動由不同記錄支持。

narrative.zh:
《利维坦》第十七章将国家的形成写成一项人与人作约并授权代表的过程。代表可以是一人，也可以是一个议事团体。这个选项不能因为书的名声而省掉，否则读者会把霍布斯正在分析的代表机制误听成先指定某种具体政体。正文可见的是他怎样逐步从个人的约定讲到集体能够以一个代表行动。对读者来说，可先把作约、授权与代表的资格画出关系，再去问这一结构针对什么问题。它也使人能分辨议论的成立条件和自己后来对制度的评价。

核对某句引文时，可以先确认句子说谁与谁作约，再标明被授权者处于什么位置。若所见引文只有一句谈到「一人」，务必查在同章同一处是否连着「或一个会议」的条件。这样的检查能避免把截取文字当成现成结论。若想将这一结构用在实际成立的政体，需要各地的制度文献。霍布斯提出一个关系模型是一件事，一件历史事件是否按该模型发生则是另一件事。用实例解释时最好明说是后人举例，使原著的说法和具体应用能够分别查证。

费马关注的是霍布斯在这一章如何将集体行动拆成能交给读者讨论的关系。不同角色之间的安排可以从文字自行核实，也会自然产生后续问题，例如谁能提出另一种授权办法，和该办法为什么改变结果。用一处明确章节来谈作者的论证方式，比说他从一开始就只想支持一种政体更易检验。若希望读下一阶段的权力议论，应标明所引章次，避免将其他地方的政治判断合成一个并不由本章承担的结论。
narrative.en:
Chapter XVII of Leviathan describes a commonwealth being formed through a covenant among individuals who authorize a representative. The representative may be one person or an assembly. Both possibilities matter to the structure of the argument. If only the first is remembered, a reader can mistake an account of representation for a decision to discuss just one particular kind of government. The chapter sets out relationships among people making an agreement and the person or body authorized to act. Those roles can be identified before one asks what problem the resulting arrangement is supposed to solve or whether the proposed solution is convincing.

A reader checking a passage can start by asking who makes a covenant with whom. Next locate the representative and establish what is being authorized. An extract containing the reference to a single person can then be compared with surrounding language to see what alternatives it leaves available. This is especially helpful where an argument about the wider book relies heavily on a short quotation. A comparison with an actual polity would require documents that show how authority was constituted there. The book provides a model of a relationship. A documented act of establishing a government is another kind of evidence. 

The profile examines how Hobbes organized a large question about collective action into relationships a reader can trace. Someone can return to the chapter and ask whether a disputed inference concerns the people making the agreement, the scope of their authorization, or the options for who represents them. Such questions provide a more precise account of his argument than a claim that the entire inquiry begins by choosing one political outcome. Further passages on power may add their own questions and should be identified by chapter when used. Here the evidence is the particular way this text makes the formation of a commonwealth available for analysis, keeping the roles visible even where readers disagree about the consequences.
narrative.zh-TW:
《利維坦》第十七章將國家的形成寫成一項人與人作約並授權代表的過程。代表可以是一人，也可以是一個議事團體。這個選項不能因為書的名聲而省掉，否則讀者會把霍布斯正在分析的代表機制誤聽成先指定某種具體政體。正文可見的是他怎樣逐步從個人的約定講到集體能夠以一個代表行動。對讀者來說，可先把作約、授權與代表的資格畫出關係，再去問這一結構針對什麼問題。它也使人能分辨議論的成立條件和自己後來對制度的評價。

核對某句引文時，可以先確認句子說誰與誰作約，再標明被授權者處於什麼位置。若所見引文只有一句談到「一人」，務必查在同章同一處是否連著「或一個會議」的條件。這樣的檢查能避免把擷取文字當成現成結論。若想將這一結構用在實際成立的政體，需要各地的制度文獻。霍布斯提出一個關係模型是一件事，一件歷史事件是否按該模型發生則是另一件事。用例項解釋時最好明說是後人舉例，使原著的說法和具體應用能夠分別查證。

費馬關注的是霍布斯在這一章如何將集體行動拆成能交給讀者討論的關係。不同角色之間的安排可以從文字自行核實，也會自然產生後續問題，例如誰能提出另一種授權辦法，和該辦法為什麼改變結果。用一處明確章節來談作者的論證方式，比說他從一開始就只想支持一種政體更易檢驗。若希望讀下一階段的權力議論，應標明所引章次，避免將其他地方的政治判斷合成一個並不由本章承擔的結論。

personalityQuestion.zh: 为什么需要同时保留霍布斯写的「一人」和「一个议事团体」？
personalityQuestion.en: Why do both possible representatives matter to a reading of Chapter XVII?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 為什麼需要同時保留霍布斯寫的「一人」和「一個議事團體」？

personalityAnswer.zh: 它们让读者看见本章讨论的是授权关系，不能用截取的一项选项代替整个机制。
personalityAnswer.en: They show that the argument specifies a relationship of authorization with more than one possible representative.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 它們讓讀者看見本章討論的是授權關係，不能用擷取的一項選項代替整個機制。

narrative.zh:
沃尔西约生于1475年，卒于1530年。英国历史皇家宫殿机构以汉普顿宫为例说明，他推动发展住处所采用的形式与欧洲文艺复兴建筑相关。这一描述把人物的活动放进一个可走访、可查布局的地点。讨论府邸所表达的地位，与描述某间房的样式究竟何时出现，是不同问题。要谈沃尔西这一阶段，可先按机构说明核定建筑工作的范围，再用相关图纸或建筑研究区分后继阶段添了什么。今天仍能看到的东西有自己的修缮史，不宜一律写成当年最初的样子。

若根据一个房间讨论府邸的使用，先找它在整体路线上的位置，再问哪些人可以到这一步。大厅与别处的用途可能不同，即使同一建筑内也不能由一处直接推出每个空间如何安排。判断文艺复兴形式与当时其他建筑的关系，可以比较来源明确的一项构件，避开凭今日印象推测设计者的意图。机构综述提供项目和背景，进一步归属某个设计决定仍会涉及工匠、管理人或另一个时段的业主。把问题分别定位可以保留居所的实际历史。

费马在此分析的是沃尔西如何通过推动一个具体工程安排居住与接待活动。若一处场所的使用关系可查，就可以从中检验为何建筑对其工作方式重要。读者也可以认为某些空间特征由常见惯例而来，提出另一个有档案的例子作对照。数字年代的近似程度和建筑中各阶段的分界都应照各自资料注明。这样，本页提供的是一次有地点可追的营建活动，而不会把后期建筑的全部含义直接归给一位参与早期发展的人。
narrative.en:
Wolsey was born around 1475 and died in 1530. Historic Royal Palaces connects his development of Hampton Court with styles found in Renaissance Europe. That gives the inquiry a particular site as well as a connection to an architectural setting. An explanation of what a residence could communicate about its occupant has a different purpose from a claim that a particular room dates to his project. The record gives an opening for examining Wolsey’s period of work. Plans, architectural research, and records of alterations can help distinguish what belongs to that period from what visitors see after the changes made by later residents. The present building has a history of its own and is not a single unaltered trace of one person.

To examine a place within the residence, identify where it lies on a route through the building and consider which people might have reached it. The uses of a hall, an approach, and a different interior need not be identical. A comparison with another building could concentrate on an identifiable feature if its provenance has been established. Impressions about style help formulate a question, but further evidence is needed to ascribe a design to someone or to explain why it was chosen. The overview identifies a project in a contemporary context. It does not turn a patron into the author of every detail or decide how later owners used the space.

The profile considers the undertaking through which Wolsey shaped a particular place for activities that required space and resources. It is possible to study that action without having to settle every question about what later generations found symbolic in the residence. A competing interpretation could identify a particular convention and compare it with a second building. That would provide better ground for disagreement than a general description of Wolsey as ambitious. The opportunity in this episode is that questions of use and choice can be tied to a site. Keeping the uncertainty of a birth date and the changes of the building as separate matters also respects what each kind of record can establish.
narrative.zh-TW:
沃爾西約生於1475年，卒於1530年。英國曆史皇家宮殿機構以漢普頓宮為例說明，他推動發展住處所採用的形式與歐洲文藝復興建築相關。這一描述把人物的活動放進一個可走訪、可查佈局的地點。討論府邸所表達的地位，與描述某間房的樣式究竟何時出現，是不同問題。要談沃爾西這一階段，可先按機構說明核定建築工作的範圍，再用相關圖紙或建築研究區分後繼階段添了什麼。今天仍能看到的東西有自己的修繕史，不宜一律寫成當年最初的樣子。

若根據一個房間討論府邸的使用，先找它在整體路線上的位置，再問哪些人可以到這一步。大廳與別處的用途可能不同，即使同一建築內也不能由一處直接推出每個空間如何安排。判斷文藝復興形式與當時其他建築的關係，可以比較來源明確的一項構件，避開憑今日印象推測設計者的意圖。機構綜述提供專案和背景，進一步歸屬某個設計決定仍會涉及工匠、管理人或另一個時段的業主。把問題分別定位可以保留居所的實際歷史。

費馬在此分析的是沃爾西如何通過推動一個具體工程安排居住與接待活動。若一處場所的使用關係可查，就可以從中檢驗為何建築對其工作方式重要。讀者也可以認為某些空間特徵由常見慣例而來，提出另一個有檔案的例子作對照。數字年代的近似程度和建築中各階段的分界都應照各自資料註明。這樣，本頁提供的是一次有地點可追的營建活動，而不會把後期建築的全部含義直接歸給一位參與早期發展的人。

personalityQuestion.zh: 沃尔西扩建汉普顿宫，怎样讨论他的选择而不混入后来的工程？
personalityQuestion.en: How can readers study Wolsey’s choices without assigning later work at Hampton Court to him?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 沃爾西擴建漢普頓宮，怎樣討論他的選擇而不混入後來的工程？

personalityAnswer.zh: 从有时间依据的工程和空间关系着手，再用图纸、建筑研究核对后续改动。
personalityAnswer.en: Start with the documented development and use evidence of alterations to separate later phases.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 從有時間依據的工程和空間關係著手，再用圖紙、建築研究核對後續改動。

narrative.zh:
意大利人物传记辞典记载，塔索大幅修订后的史诗以《被征服的耶路撒冷》为题，于1593年刊行，共二十四歌。新版的题名和结构让读者能确定该从什么地方开始比较。若只说塔索修改了关于耶路撒冷的史诗，很容易将较早的作品和后出的文本当作同一份书。章数变化可把不同时间的读者遇到的版本分开，却不能替代指出实际改过的部分。书目为比较给出两个可核对的对象，至于每处删增给叙事带来什么变化，应当回到作品。

对照时可以挑一个两个文本都能辨认的事件，标出它之前的转场和之后的收束。如果同一件事的篇幅、位置或发话人发生了改变，应分别记下。若要解释作者为什么调整某一处，有时还需要序文、评论或写作过程中留下的记录。二十四歌是一个可核实的总数，单靠它不能证明新增文字全在最后，也不能替作品作文学评判。辞典说明刊行的年份和篇章构成，使认为某一改动属于另一版本的说法可以很快被查验。

费马从这项再组织既有作品的行动考察塔索怎样重返已完成的长篇。重修使原先已经公开的结构再度成为可调整的对象。说他采取哪一种写作办法，需要明确是哪一支故事、哪一种文本差异，不能只拿另一版本的题名将所有变化概括为新方向。即使读者喜爱较早的作品，也能对晚版究竟做过何种修改作独立判断。传记使用的就是这件可比较的行动，关于日后接受与评价，则应另外查能够证成阅读和流通的材料。
narrative.en:
The Italian biographical dictionary records the publication of Tasso’s revised epic as Gerusalemme conquistata in 1593, with twenty-four cantos. Both the title and the structure can be used to identify the text for a comparison. A statement that he revised an epic about Jerusalem can blur two forms in which different readers might have encountered it. The count of cantos helps separate those encounters but cannot show where in the story the changes occur. An edition record is an appropriate place to verify that the later work had a particular title and scale. A reader interested in what the revisions do will have to follow individual passages.

One way to compare the texts is to find an event that can be recognized in both and record what leads into it and what follows it. A change of position, extent, or speaker can be described without assuming that another nearby passage was changed for the same reason. Explanations of an author’s choice may be aided by a preface or records of composition where they can be linked to the relevant passage. A difference in the total number of cantos does not establish that all added material came at the end. Nor is it a judgment of the new work’s literary effects. The bibliographic description supplies a check on version and date before claims about narrative are attached to the appropriate text.

The action examined in the profile is returning to a large work whose earlier structure was already available to readers. This provides an opportunity to study revision on a scale beyond the replacement of a word. It also gives someone a way to disagree with an account of the revision by identifying which part of the work follows another pattern. Preference for one text need not prevent that comparison. A larger account of why Tasso revisited the work and what later readers made of it would benefit from evidence concerning composition and reception. The immediate evidence is the existence of a differently named and organized publication that allows the observable changes to be discussed in their own right.
narrative.zh-TW:
義大利人物傳記辭典記載，塔索大幅修訂後的史詩以《被征服的耶路撒冷》為題，於1593年刊行，共二十四歌。新版的題名和結構讓讀者能確定該從什麼地方開始比較。若只說塔索修改了關於耶路撒冷的史詩，很容易將較早的作品和後出的文本當作同一份書。章數變化可把不同時間的讀者遇到的版本分開，卻不能替代指出實際改過的部分。書目為比較給出兩個可核對的對象，至於每處刪增給敘事帶來什麼變化，應當回到作品。

對照時可以挑一個兩個文本都能辨認的事件，標出它之前的轉場和之後的收束。如果同一件事的篇幅、位置或發話人發生了改變，應分別記下。若要解釋作者為什麼調整某一處，有時還需要序文、評論或寫作過程中留下的記錄。二十四歌是一個可核實的總數，單靠它不能證明新增文字全在最後，也不能替作品作文學評判。辭典說明刊行的年份和篇章構成，使認為某一改動屬於另一版本的說法可以很快被查驗。

費馬從這項再組織既有作品的行動考察塔索怎樣重返已完成的長篇。重修使原先已經公開的結構再度成為可調整的對象。說他採取哪一種寫作辦法，需要明確是哪一支故事、哪一種文本差異，不能只拿另一版本的題名將所有變化概括為新方向。即使讀者喜愛較早的作品，也能對晚版究竟做過何種修改作獨立判斷。傳記使用的就是這件可比較的行動，關於日後接受與評價，則應另外查能夠證成閱讀和流通的材料。

personalityQuestion.zh: 塔索1593年改本的题名和歌数能帮助核对什么？
personalityQuestion.en: What can the title and canto count establish about Tasso’s revision?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 塔索1593年改本的題名和歌數能幫助核對什麼？

personalityAnswer.zh: 它们确定要比较的是哪一份改本，具体删改应再对照章节。
personalityAnswer.en: They identify the revised work before claims about particular changes are checked against its text.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 它們確定要比較的是哪一份改本，具體刪改應再對照章節。

narrative.zh:
美国国家公园管理局把格兰特的回忆文字分为几个阶段：起初拒绝邀约，后来为《世纪杂志》写稿，继而展开回忆录。这样的次序比将他从一开始就写成决意完成整部生涯叙述更符合记录。杂志文章的范围可以集中到一个事件，回忆录则要求读者在多个时期之间找到线索。一次写作任务与下一项工作可以有关联，但不能据此推定作者当初已有完整目录。若要说明他在哪一步改变主意，该机构的线索能给读者找到进一步比较的材料。

例如，可选一件两种文本都提及的事情，记录文章从哪里起笔、何处收束，再看回忆录的相关章节前后多了哪些时间信息。媒介变化可能使一段叙述承担完全不同的任务。有的地方需要让单篇读者迅速看出事件的影响，有的地方可依靠前章已经介绍的人物。一个故事被重复书写，不意味两次都为了同一种读者。若作者把以前的委托写作改进书里，还应查出版本及发表先后，明确哪一处编辑选择已经可以被当作事实。

费马观察的是格兰特如何从有界限的写作过渡到组织更长的记录。前面出现过拒绝这一点很重要，它让读者有机会看见写作目标会随着实际经历调整。材料表明哪些工作相继发生，不能替分析者算出每个决定背后所有原因。若要谈经济、出版协商或个人处境，应分别查对应时间的书信和档案。由杂志文章转入回忆录这一可核动作已经可以讨论，读者也可据两种成稿比较它们怎样交代相同事件。
narrative.en:
The National Park Service account of Grant’s writing distinguishes initial refusals, articles for Century Magazine, and the subsequent work on his memoirs. This sequence gives a reader a way to consider a change in plans. A magazine article can focus on an event with an identifiable beginning and endpoint. A memoir can bring events from several periods into one account and ask a reader to follow relationships across chapters. The existence of an article can matter to the later undertaking without showing that its author already had a full book in mind when he agreed to write it. The chronology provides a place to investigate what made each decision possible.

Select an event that can be found in both kinds of writing. Record how the article introduces it, when it ends, and what the corresponding part of the memoir can rely on the reader already knowing. A passage that explains something for a person encountering the subject for the first time might have a different task in a sequence of chapters. The placement of an episode can therefore be compared along with its wording. If a claim concerns material adapted from an earlier commission, identify the order and terms of publication. Otherwise a resemblance could be taken as the whole proof of how the change occurred. The Park Service account gives identifiable stages rather than a claim that all details of the transition are known.

The profile considers the change from writing on a restricted scale to organizing a longer record. The initial refusals matter because they allow the eventual work to be studied as a change in conduct, not merely as the fulfilment of a fixed intention. The source identifies successive work without supplying every reason that a decision was made. A study of finances or negotiations with a publisher would need the records that bear on those matters. The articles and memoir can already be compared to see what work the same event was made to do in each. Keeping their original purposes visible makes the biographical episode more informative than reading the earlier choices in the light of the book’s later prominence.
narrative.zh-TW:
美國國家公園管理局把格蘭特的回憶文字分為幾個階段：起初拒絕邀約，後來為《世紀雜誌》寫稿，繼而展開回憶錄。這樣的次序比將他從一開始就寫成決意完成整部生涯敘述更符合記錄。雜誌文章的範圍可以集中到一個事件，回憶錄則要求讀者在多個時期之間找到線索。一次寫作任務與下一項工作可以有關聯，但不能據此推定作者當初已有完整目錄。若要說明他在哪一步改變主意，該機構的線索能給讀者找到進一步比較的材料。

例如，可選一件兩種文本都提及的事情，記錄文章從哪裡起筆、何處收束，再看回憶錄的相關章節前後多了哪些時間資訊。媒介變化可能使一段敘述承擔完全不同的任務。有的地方需要讓單篇讀者迅速看出事件的影響，有的地方可依靠前章已經介紹的人物。一個故事被重複書寫，不意味兩次都為了同一種讀者。若作者把以前的委託寫作改進書裡，還應查出版本及發表先後，明確哪一處編輯選擇已經可以被當作事實。

費馬觀察的是格蘭特如何從有界限的寫作過渡到組織更長的記錄。前面出現過拒絕這一點很重要，它讓讀者有機會看見寫作目標會隨著實際經歷調整。材料表明哪些工作相繼發生，不能替分析者算出每個決定背後所有原因。若要談經濟、出版協商或個人處境，應分別查對應時間的書信和檔案。由雜誌文章轉入回憶錄這一可核動作已經可以討論，讀者也可據兩種成稿比較它們怎樣交代相同事件。

personalityQuestion.zh: 从《世纪杂志》到回忆录，费马关注的是格兰特怎样调整工作？
personalityQuestion.en: What change of work can be checked between Grant’s magazine articles and memoirs?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 從《世紀雜誌》到回憶錄，費馬關注的是格蘭特怎樣調整工作？

personalityAnswer.zh: 单篇可围绕一件事，回忆录要把不同阶段组织成可连续阅读的记录。
personalityAnswer.en: The sequence lets readers examine a move from individual accounts to a longer narrative project.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 單篇可圍繞一件事，回憶錄要把不同階段組織成可連續閱讀的記錄。

narrative.zh:
库赞翻译柏拉图著作的目录给出具体编排。《申辩篇》和《克里同篇》等列在第一卷，《理想国》则跨第九、第十两卷。公开文库保留卷次，读者可以先确认文本各在何处，再选择怎样阅读。目录的用处不只在于找到页码。对于首次接触这些对话的人，同卷收录会让几篇文章较容易连续读，跨卷则可能需要读者在另一个地方接上同一部著作。若今天只用单篇电子版，原有的次序和卷帙限制容易变得不明显。

研究这项设计，可以把一处文字放回书目，先看它邻接哪些对话，再问同时出现是否足够表明编者设定了明确的思想路线。内页的说明、序言及刊行安排，能帮助判断编排究竟出于阅读考虑还是其他条件。若查跨卷接续，应注意断点有没有特殊说明，在核对译句时也不能因此跳过另一卷。目录为研究提供实际书的位置，不一定能直接告诉人译者为何考虑每个细节。把看得见的编排与作者动机分开，才能继续判断哪一份材料的证据最强。

费马观察的是库赞让一套著作以有明确次序的卷次进入读者视野。翻译的工作不只决定单句如何表达，也可以决定读者通常从何处开始寻找篇目。目录确立了现象，相关版本保存了细部。若另一个系列把同样对话放在不同位置，便可比较哪些入口和查阅方式因此改变。理解此事不需要先认定编排能够证明译者的全部哲学主张。此处能谈的是一项书的组织活动、它对翻阅造成的具体影响，以及读者还可通过什么材料检验解释。
narrative.en:
The table of contents of Victor Cousin’s translation places the Apology and Crito among the dialogues in volume I and divides the Republic between volumes IX and X. The public edition retains volume numbers, which help readers reconstruct what they might encounter together when consulting the set. A single electronic text can conceal both the neighbors of a short dialogue and the physical break within a longer work. Establishing the locations gives a place to begin a study of the arrangement before making any claim about the way one dialogue was translated. It also prevents a reference to the Republic from being treated as if it could always be completed in one volume.

Begin with a passage generally read by itself. Locate it in the series, then inspect the works a reader would find before and after it. Proximity does not demonstrate that the translator prescribed a program of study. An introduction, information on publication, or a statement about the arrangement may help address why a decision was made. The point at which a work crosses a volume boundary can also be studied. An explanation for that division should not be inferred solely from a modern reading of the passage. The contents locate the organization plainly enough for a reader to check it independently. They leave open which determinations require evidence from the preface, the publication process, or the works themselves.

FermatMind’s reading concerns giving a large body of writings a navigable publication order. Translation can involve expressing individual sentences, and a collected edition also affects how readers find and move between the texts. One can compare an alternate series with the same dialogues in other locations to see which points of entry it offers. That comparison would not by itself decide a question about translation accuracy or establish the translator’s own philosophy. The evidence used here makes a more specific observation possible: particular texts were arranged within a set under identifiable volume boundaries. Knowing those boundaries makes subsequent questions about references, organization, and the experience of consultation easier to put and test.
narrative.zh-TW:
庫贊翻譯柏拉圖著作的目錄給出具體編排。《申辯篇》和《克里同篇》等列在第一卷，《理想國》則跨第九、第十兩卷。公開文庫保留卷次，讀者可以先確認文本各在何處，再選擇怎樣閱讀。目錄的用處不只在於找到頁碼。對於首次接觸這些對話的人，同卷收錄會讓幾篇文章較容易連續讀，跨卷則可能需要讀者在另一個地方接上同一部著作。若今天只用單篇電子版，原有的次序和卷帙限制容易變得不明顯。

研究這項設計，可以把一處文字放回書目，先看它鄰接哪些對話，再問同時出現是否足夠表明編者設定了明確的思想路線。內頁的說明、序言及刊行安排，能幫助判斷編排究竟出於閱讀考慮還是其他條件。若查跨卷接續，應注意斷點有沒有特殊說明，在核對譯句時也不能因此跳過另一卷。目錄為研究提供實際書的位置，不一定能直接告訴人譯者為何考慮每個細節。把看得見的編排與作者動機分開，才能繼續判斷哪一份材料的證據最強。

費馬觀察的是庫贊讓一套著作以有明確次序的卷次進入讀者視野。翻譯的工作不只決定單句如何表達，也可以決定讀者通常從何處開始尋找篇目。目錄確立了現象，相關版本保存了細部。若另一個系列把同樣對話放在不同位置，便可比較哪些入口和查閱方式因此改變。理解此事不需要先認定編排能夠證明譯者的全部哲學主張。此處能談的是一項書的組織活動、它對翻閱造成的具體影響，以及讀者還可通過什麼材料檢驗解釋。

personalityQuestion.zh: 同为柏拉图对话，库赞的不同卷次如何帮助理解他的编排？
personalityQuestion.en: What do Cousin’s volume divisions let readers examine about the edition?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 同為柏拉圖對話，庫讚的不同卷次如何幫助理解他的編排？

personalityAnswer.zh: 可查哪些对话同卷，哪些作品须跨卷接续，再用版本材料判断安排的理由。
personalityAnswer.en: The contents reveal how readers could move among texts or continue a single work across volumes.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 可查哪些對話同卷，哪些作品須跨卷接續，再用版本材料判斷安排的理由。

narrative.zh:
阿尔菲耶里的亲笔初稿可从德桑克蒂斯基金会展览目录追到佛罗伦萨劳伦齐亚纳图书馆，馆藏号Alfieri 13，叶码132正面至197背面。这个范围说明查的是尚在形成时的一段文本，不宜把它当成后世通行印本。归于「亲笔」涉及手稿的身份，「初稿」则涉及它处于写作的哪个阶段。如果读者要判断一处改动先写了什么，应尽量看到手稿本身，而不能把目录的概括当成已经辨读了每一笔。目录给出的价值在于，将这一阶段定位在可以继续申请或查阅的页叶。

可先从有明确对应位置的一段着手，记录写在正文行内的字和后来出现在行间或边上的字。若有涂去或改写，不必立即确定每一处的先后。手稿自身有时只能显示两种措辞在同一叶留下痕迹，比较誊清稿或后来的印本才可能把它们接成序列。使用叶码时也要分清正、背面，免得把在同一张纸上出现的两处文字合并。若研究关心作品如何完成，能说明哪一份更晚及其依据，比仅列出一个看起来完整的版本更重要。

人物档案以这份可定位的初稿谈写作不是只剩后来交付给读者的成品。费马关注作品从草拟到定稿之间有何可见决定。公开目录本身能够确认到什么位置寻找，但在未阅读全文影像之前，不主张某个人物或情节一定在某次改写中变了。未来若拿到后续见证，可以按句或按段落对照，而不用从后来印本猜想最早一定如何。这样呈现手稿，也让读者知道用来讨论写作的首先是一件有馆藏身份和位置的历史物件。
narrative.en:
The De Sanctis Foundation exhibition catalogue locates Alfieri’s autograph first draft in the Laurentian Library manuscript Alfieri 13, folios 132 recto through 197 verso. These details identify an object and a stage in the making of the work. The designation autograph bears on whose hand produced the manuscript. The designation first draft bears on the draft’s place in a sequence. A published edition in ordinary use is a different witness. It cannot replace the manuscript for a claim about an early wording or the arrangement of marks on a leaf. The value of the catalogue is that it gives both a shelf mark and a range a researcher can use to locate the relevant material.

A comparison can start with a passage whose place in two versions is recognizable. A transcription can distinguish writing in a line from writing in the margin or between lines. If more than one wording is visible, it may be possible to record both without knowing the order of every alteration. A fair copy or a later printing can sometimes help establish a sequence. Naming the recto or verso matters when several observations concern the same leaf. The catalogue identifies the stage at which to ask those questions. Its description cannot stand in for reading a specific revision, and it does not need to do so to provide a useful starting point.

The profile uses the surviving evidence of drafting to consider how a work took shape before reaching its readers. A claim about the writer’s practice can remain narrow enough to specify a particular witness rather than converting the final text into a statement about what had always been intended. The first draft is available to locate and subsequent witnesses may offer points of comparison. Until those comparisons are made, there is no need to claim that a particular character or episode changed in a particular revision. The manuscript gives an identifiable place in which to investigate a writing decision. That specificity is what lets a discussion of authorial practice move beyond a general impression of the published work.
narrative.zh-TW:
阿爾菲耶裡的親筆初稿可從德桑克蒂斯基金會展覽目錄追到佛羅倫薩勞倫齊亞納圖書館，館藏號Alfieri 13，葉碼132正面至197背面。這個範圍說明查的是尚在形成時的一段文本，不宜把它當成後世通行印本。歸於「親筆」涉及手稿的身份，「初稿」則涉及它處於寫作的哪個階段。如果讀者要判斷一處改動先寫了什麼，應儘量看到手稿本身，而不能把目錄的概括當成已經辨讀了每一筆。目錄給出的價值在於，將這一階段定位在可以繼續申請或查閱的頁葉。

可先從有明確對應位置的一段著手，記錄寫在正文行內的字和後來出現在行間或邊上的字。若有塗去或改寫，不必立即確定每一處的先後。手稿自身有時只能顯示兩種措辭在同一葉留下痕跡，比較謄清稿或後來的印本才可能把它們接成序列。使用葉碼時也要分清正、背面，免得把在同一張紙上出現的兩處文字合併。若研究關心作品如何完成，能說明哪一份更晚及其依據，比僅列出一個看起來完整的版本更重要。

人物檔案以這份可定位的初稿談寫作不是隻剩後來交付給讀者的成品。費馬關注作品從草擬到定稿之間有何可見決定。公開目錄本身能夠確認到什麼位置尋找，但在未閱讀全文影像之前，不主張某個人物或情節一定在某次改寫中變了。未來若拿到後續見證，可以按句或按段落對照，而不用從後來印本猜想最早一定如何。這樣呈現手稿，也讓讀者知道用來討論寫作的首先是一件有館藏身份和位置的歷史對象。

personalityQuestion.zh: 阿尔菲耶里的初稿馆藏号和叶码分别帮助确认什么？
personalityQuestion.en: What do the shelf mark and folios let readers verify about Alfieri’s draft?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 阿爾菲耶裡的初稿館藏號和葉碼分別幫助確認什麼？

personalityAnswer.zh: 馆藏号识别手稿，正背叶码标出初稿范围，便于和后出的文本对读。
personalityAnswer.en: They identify the manuscript and locate an early stage that can be compared with later witnesses.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 館藏號識別手稿，正背葉碼標出初稿範圍，便於和後出的文本對讀。

narrative.zh:
雷利约生于1552年，卒于1618年。加州大学洛杉矶分校克拉克图书馆的首版记录，将《世界史》的写作放在伦敦塔，并标明1614年末匿名刊出的第一卷叙事至公元前130年。先把写作地点、印本署名和覆盖范围分开，能够避免三个常见混淆：作者在一处生活并不等于书在同处印行，匿名出版不等于今日无法查证作者，现存卷的终点也不能代替他可能设想的全部写作范围。书目给出了可核的文本及时间，读者从它开始便能问这些条件如何影响作品进入读者视野。

如果要检查第一卷怎样选取历史终点，可以分别读接近最后事件的正文和前置说明，再追问是叙述本身标出了终点，还是后来的书目将最后内容如此标识。这种比较可以让关于写作计划的说法有出处。若研究者希望了解他在伦敦塔能够使用哪些书，仍需要通信、借阅记录或正文能查明的引用。知道写作地点可以说明当时身在何处，却无法直接提供书房清单。初版匿名的事实则可和书名页对应，至于读者当时是否知道作者身份，要找他们确实提到该书的文字。

费马用这份材料观察雷利怎样在特定环境里组织跨度很大的写作，并将到达的部分交给出版。结点和署名状况使这一行动可以由印本复核，也留出空间给新的写作经历证据。用这项行事方式讨论人物时，不应从一卷的边界反推他的全部长远意图。若其他来源给出了更细的计划，也应明确是设想、书稿还是发行。这样的区分让眼下可以查的文本与尚未落实的计划都得到清楚位置。
narrative.en:
Raleigh was born around 1552 and died in 1618. The Clark Library’s record places the writing of his History of the World in the Tower of London. It identifies the first volume as having appeared anonymously in late 1614 and describes its reach to 130 BCE. These details answer different questions. A place of writing is not automatically a place of printing. An anonymous title page can coexist with other evidence of authorship. The last event in a surviving volume gives a limit for reading that volume without describing every ambition the author may have had for the project. The source provides identifiable conditions in which to examine the production and appearance of a considerable historical work.

To check how the scope was established, read the final part of the narrative alongside the relevant bibliographic description. A researcher can see whether the text explicitly identifies its endpoint or the date is supplied by a catalogue’s account of the last events. An assertion about the original plan would need language in a preface, letter, or draft that specifies more. The writer’s circumstances in the Tower also raise a question about the material he could consult. The location does not by itself tell us which books reached him. Citations, correspondence, or a record of a delivery could help establish what he actually had to work with. 

The profile examines the production of a long historical account under identifiable conditions and the appearance of a bounded part of that undertaking in print. Both the context and the endpoint can be checked. The available text can then be compared with new information about drafting without confusing a plan for more with a published continuation. One can acknowledge an ambitious work and still ask what particular action is visible in its first edition. The library entry gives enough detail to investigate that question without assigning every feature of the history to a single circumstance of composition.
narrative.zh-TW:
雷利約生於1552年，卒於1618年。加州大學洛杉磯分校克拉克圖書館的首版記錄，將《世界史》的寫作放在倫敦塔，並標明1614年末匿名刊出的第一卷敘事至西元前130年。先把寫作地點、印本署名和覆蓋範圍分開，能夠避免三個常見混淆：作者在一處生活並不等於書在同處印行，匿名出版不等於今日無法查證作者，現存卷的終點也不能代替他可能設想的全部寫作範圍。書目給出了可核的文本及時間，讀者從它開始便能問這些條件如何影響作品進入讀者視野。

如果要檢查第一卷怎樣選取歷史終點，可以分別讀接近最後事件的正文和前置說明，再追問是敘述本身標出了終點，還是後來的書目將最後內容如此標識。這種比較可以讓關於寫作計劃的說法有出處。若研究者希望瞭解他在倫敦塔能夠使用哪些書，仍需要通訊、借閱記錄或正文能查明的引用。知道寫作地點可以說明當時身在何處，卻無法直接提供書房清單。初版匿名的事實則可和書名頁對應，至於讀者當時是否知道作者身份，要找他們確實提到該書的文字。

費馬用這份材料觀察雷利怎樣在特定環境裡組織跨度很大的寫作，並將到達的部分交給出版。結點和署名狀況使這一行動可以由印本複核，也留出空間給新的寫作經歷證據。用這項行事方式討論人物時，不應從一卷的邊界反推他的全部長遠意圖。若其他來源給出了更細的計劃，也應明確是設想、書稿還是發行。這樣的區分讓眼下可以查的文本與尚未落實的計劃都得到清楚位置。

personalityQuestion.zh: 雷利在伦敦塔写作与匿名付印是同一类证据吗？
personalityQuestion.en: Why keep the place of writing apart from anonymous publication in Raleigh’s profile?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 雷利在倫敦塔寫作與匿名付印是同一類證據嗎？

personalityAnswer.zh: 地点说明工作环境，首版说明交到读者手里的文本怎样出现。
personalityAnswer.en: The Tower locates composition, while the edition identifies a distinct decision about how the text appeared.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 地點說明工作環境，首版說明交到讀者手裡的文本怎樣出現。

narrative.zh:
惠康收藏的《沃伦·黑斯廷斯的辩护》版本，将辩护文字放在下议院程序和1786年提出的指控背景中。书名和相关说明的作用，是让读者辨认这份文字原本面向什么制度场合。被指控者的解释、指控文本以及议会最终如何处理，都有各自的出处。若把他本人一份陈述当成全过程，就会让其他参与者的证据退出画面。版本记录有助于预先标好文献位置：这是可以追查的答辩，不能代替提出指控者的说明或对后来结果的认定。

读一个答复，可以先找到它指的是哪项指控，再看答复是不同意事实叙述、否认一项权力的解释，还是为有关行为提出理由。若几种内容出现在同一页，也不必把它们都读成相同的辩护方式。还可将引文与原先提出指控的段落并读，避免作者自己的复述在摘录时取代他真正需要回应的文字。讨论该文件之后造成的结果，要回到其他审议记录和日期。书目使读者能够用同一版本定位答辩的语境，但不会为每项政治及道德判断提供结论。

费马选择的是一位身处正式问责程序的人怎样将应答变成可以查读和批评的文字。把指控和回应逐项对照，能够看出什么被正面处理、什么仍需别的证据。提出这一观察不等于接受被指控人提供的解释，也不应割裂该程序与殖民统治活动的背景。更大的历史问题需从当地产生的材料和其他人的叙述入手。此页将确切的文本身份与讨论次序保留下来，使传记解读以一项可核的应答活动为起点，而不拿人物自己的声音覆盖整个事件。
narrative.en:
The Wellcome Collection holds an edition of The Defence of Warren Hastings that identifies proceedings in the House of Commons and charges presented in 1786. The described setting is important for reading a document that makes a case on its author’s behalf. A statement of defence can tell us how a respondent chose to frame an answer. The allegations and whatever determination later resulted have to be located separately. Using the defence to replace the whole record would let one participant determine the terms in which every other piece of evidence was read. The edition provides a place to establish which proceeding the text identifies and what kind of document it is before relying on any statement in it.

For a close comparison, find an allegation and then identify the response that concerns it. A respondent might contest an account of what happened, challenge an interpretation of authority, or offer a reason for a course of action. Even where several such steps occur in one passage, it helps to state their different purposes. Bringing the original allegation alongside the answer can prevent a paraphrase within the defence from quietly replacing the wording to which the respondent was expected to reply. A claim about the outcome would then require dated records of a subsequent stage. The catalogue identifies a historically situated item. It does not validate individual answers or supply a judgment on the broader history to which they belong.

The episode considered in the profile is the move from being required to respond to making that response available as a defined text. A reader can examine the organization of a reply without accepting that reply’s conclusions. If a question concerns colonial government or the experiences of people affected by it, their records deserve to be consulted on their own terms. The document used here remains evidence about the choices embodied in a formal answer. That precision helps readers distinguish what the author addressed directly from what would have to be investigated elsewhere, and it leaves the other participants in the proceedings an evidential place of their own.
narrative.zh-TW:
惠康收藏的《沃倫·黑斯廷斯的辯護》版本，將辯護文字放在下議院程序和1786年提出的指控背景中。書名和相關說明的作用，是讓讀者辨認這份文字原本面向什麼制度場合。被指控者的解釋、指控文本以及議會最終如何處理，都有各自的出處。若把他本人一份陳述當成全過程，就會讓其他參與者的證據退出畫面。版本記錄有助於預先標好文獻位置：這是可以追查的答辯，不能代替提出指控者的說明或對後來結果的認定。

讀一個答覆，可以先找到它指的是哪項指控，再看答覆是不同意事實敘述、否認一項權力的解釋，還是為有關行為提出理由。若幾種內容出現在同一頁，也不必把它們都讀成相同的辯護方式。還可將引文與原先提出指控的段落並讀，避免作者自己的複述在摘錄時取代他真正需要回應的文字。討論該檔案之後造成的結果，要回到其他審議記錄和日期。書目使讀者能夠用同一版本定位答辯的語境，但不會為每項政治及道德判斷提供結論。

費馬選擇的是一位身處正式問責程序的人怎樣將應答變成可以查讀和批評的文字。把指控和回應逐項對照，能夠看出什麼被正面處理、什麼仍需別的證據。提出這一觀察不等於接受被指控人提供的解釋，也不應割裂該程序與殖民統治活動的背景。更大的歷史問題需從當地產生的材料和其他人的敘述入手。此頁將確切的文本身份與討論次序保留下來，使傳記解讀以一項可核的應答活動為起點，而不拿人物自己的聲音覆蓋整個事件。

personalityQuestion.zh: 为什么费马将黑斯廷斯的答辩和原有指控分开核查？
personalityQuestion.en: Why read Hastings’s defence beside the charges rather than as a record of the whole proceeding?
personalityQuestion.zh-TW: 為什麼費馬將黑斯廷斯的答辯和原有指控分開核查？

personalityAnswer.zh: 答辩显示他怎么组织回应，指控原文及后续结论则应分别查证。
personalityAnswer.en: The defence documents one participant’s response and cannot establish every other part of the proceeding.
personalityAnswer.zh-TW: 答辯顯示他怎麼組織回應，指控原文及後續結論則應分別查證。

narrative.zh:
英国议会档案描述柯贝特1821至1826年间在英格兰东南部和中部走访。县里的会议和与村民的交谈进入他在《政治纪事》发表的材料，后来与《乡村骑行记》联系起来。这里有一条可以贯通的路径：人去了哪些地方，听到什么类型的陈述，又让印刷读者接触到哪些内容。把路径写清，比只称作者了解乡村有用。读者可查看一段文字来自观察、对话还是会议发言，然后再问作者用它支撑了什么说法。

核查可从选定一期刊物开始，记下刊发日与文中曾到访之处，再确认叙述中哪些人亲历相关事务。这一步也能看见漏失：旅程只经过特定地方，并不是均匀调查各地，改成书以后还可能调整在刊物中原来的顺序。若一段文字报告一人对地方状况的看法，宜保留这人是谁、说话环境以及作者用了怎样的总结，并不把它直接用作全地区状况的测量。另一位旅行者或居民若给出不同记载，可以按实际日期和地点查它们是否说的是同一件事。

费马由此讨论柯贝特怎样将采访和现场经验带给没有沿路同行的读者。定期发表使部分沿途见闻以可定位的形式流通。由此可以研究作者如何选择听谁说话、让哪项议题进入报刊，而不是把行程本身写成他对一切地方事务的权威。比较初刊和后出的篇章，还可进一步问什么被重新组织。议会的资料能为实际走访和发表出口提供线索，具体引文应继续由正文确认。
narrative.en:
Parliament’s collection connects Cobbett’s travels in southeastern England and the Midlands between 1821 and 1826 with material published in The Political Register. County meetings and conversations with villagers formed part of the activity described. This gives a route to follow from being in a place to selecting what people elsewhere could read about it. It is useful to keep a direct observation, a comment from another person, and a report of a meeting identifiable before considering the political work each does in the writing. The collection places journeys and publication within a recognizable period. An account of a particular claim can then look for when Cobbett was in a place and how he presented what he heard there.

A researcher might start from an individual issue, note its publication date, and identify the location and participants a passage actually names. A trip goes through particular communities and does not sample every place equally. A move from periodical to book can also affect the order in which a reader meets the material. When a passage reports what one person thought about local conditions, the identity and position of that speaker are material to assessing what the statement can support.
